<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Opt-in `--monokernel` decode for Qwen3.8-2.4T (`amd/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B-Quark-MXFP4`, `Qwen3_5MoeForCausalLM`) at TP8 on MI355X. Laid out per the specialized-decode RFC #60904 under `vllm/models/qwen3_5/amd/specialized_decode/`, as Qwen3.8-Flash-Next's (#63032). A decode step of 1–16 rows runs two persistent FlyDSL launches a layer; everything else runs vLLM's forward. No core changes beyond the `--monokernel` docstring.

## Claims

- Decode TPOT at 1–16 concurrent requests on MI355X TP8: −33% at 1 (8.36 → 5.61 ms, 8k/1k), −18% at 8, −9% at 16; above 16 rows steps run stock (within 1%).
- Accuracy within noise of stock: GSM8K 0.976 vs 0.973, GPQA Diamond (thinking, 198 questions) 0.919 vs 0.934 (±0.019 per run). GSM8K under `VLLM_GPU_SYNC_CHECK=error` (Triton GDN prefill, since AITER's FlyDSL GDN prefill metadata syncs the host on prefills) completes with 0.968: no host syncs in the decode path. RULER NIAH at 64k / 128k: being measured.
- Follows RFC #60904: `--monokernel` switch, default-deny refusals in three stages (each listing every reason, TP ranks agreeing), one `plan()` per step, MRV2 only, model-owned code, weights and caches read in place.
- A rank whose cross-rank wait gives up (10 s) marks itself failed; the TP ranks raise together within 16 steps, so the engine stops rather than hangs (tested with a stalled rank).
- Kernel numerics tests (TP8, MI355X) and CPU refusal/routing tests, with a Buildkite MI355 (8 GPU) step.

## Validation

**Serving** (MI355X TP8, `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-5d35ce3934a7804b298559d2d99eec33792e1eb9` with this branch's `vllm/models/qwen3_5/amd/` and model hook overlaid; both arms `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`, AITER fused shared experts, FULL CUDA graphs, FP8 KV cache, prefix caching off, `--max-num-seqs 256`; stock adds nothing, the candidate adds `--monokernel`; `vllm bench serve` random dataset, about 4× concurrency prompts (at least 8), as many warmups as concurrency; mean TPOT, ms):

| concurrency | 8k/1k stock | 8k/1k `--monokernel` | 1k/1k stock | 1k/1k `--monokernel` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 8.36 | 5.61 (−33%) | 8.33 | 5.59 (−33%) |
| 2 | 8.82 | 6.45 (−27%) | 8.81 | 6.46 (−27%) |
| 4 | 10.47 | 8.38 (−20%) | 10.35 | 8.15 (−21%) |
| 8 | 13.78 | 11.30 (−18%) | 12.80 | 10.39 (−19%) |
| 12 | 18.51 | 16.98 (−8%) | 16.34 | 14.83 (−9%) |
| 16 | 19.23 | 17.55 (−9%) | 16.51 | 15.00 (−9%) |
| 24 | | | 19.25 | 19.28 |
| 32 | | | 21.99 | 22.14 |
| 48 | | | 26.51 | 26.71 |
| 64 | | | 29.55 | 29.76 |

**Per launch** (µs, TP8 on MI355X, each launch in a CUDA graph of 46, weights rotated over enough copies that the 256 MB MALL does not hold a layer's weights across launches, random routing):

| rows | GDN block | layer block (out_proj MXFP4) | layer block (o_proj BF16, gated) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 13.3 | 32.2 | 35.9 |
| 2 | 15.3 | 38.2 | 42.9 |
| 4 | 19.8 | 54.8 | 59.0 |
| 8 | 25.4 | 74.1 | 78.8 |
| 12 | 30.6 | 99.0 | 104.7 |
| 16 | 34.7 | 120.8 | 127.2 |

From 8 rows up the layer block's routed experts stream about 6 TB/s of MXFP4 weights; the rest is the all-reduce, norm and route hand-offs (about 3 µs each between CTAs).

**Tests** (MI355X, `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-5d35ce3934a7804b298559d2d99eec33792e1eb9` with this branch's `vllm/models/qwen3_5/amd/` overlaid, `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 pytest -v -s tests/models/qwen3_5/amd_specialized_decode`): all 41 tests pass.

- `test_kernels.py`: the GDN block against the Gemma residual add + norm, in_proj, AITER's conv update and fused gated delta rule and `RMSNormGated` at widths 1, 5, 8, 9, 16 (pad rows included, first layer included), on either MXFP4 GEMM layout; the layer block against o_proj / out_proj, the all-reduce, `fused_add_rms_norm`, the router's softmax top-10, the MXFP4 experts with the fused shared expert and the MoE all-reduce at widths 1, 3, 8, 9, 15, 16 (each twice: both epoch parities), on all 8 ranks with rank agreement and the health words left clear. A stalled-rank test launches the layer block on rank 0 only: its waits give up after ~10 s, the failed word and rank 0's flag are set, the given-up waits name only mailbox regions of this kernel, and the next launch returns at once.
- `test_runtime.py` (host side, no kernels launched; skipped off ROCm like `test_kernels.py`): off without the flag, every-reason refusal messages, parallel/feature refusals, the PIECEWISE warning, and `plan()` routing.
- Serving: `--monokernel` compiles 64 builds (92 layers, widths 1–16) at startup, captures FULL graphs, and takes specialized steps.

## Details

**Launches.** Per layer: (1) on the GDN layers, the GDN block: residual add + input_layernorm, in_proj_qkvz (MXFP4) and in_proj_ba, the conv update, the gated delta rule on the cached states, RMSNormGated; on the full attention layers vLLM's input norm and attention run instead, up to o_proj's input. (2) The layer block: out_proj (MXFP4) / o_proj (BF16, with the output gate), the TP all-reduce, the residual add + post_attention_layernorm, the router's softmax top-10 and the shared-expert gate, the MXFP4 experts with the fused shared expert (expert 512), the TP all-reduce. Embeddings, final norm, head and sampling stay vLLM's.

**x without an LDS tile.** At H = 8192 a 16-row bf16 x is 262 KB, more than a CU's LDS, so neither launch holds it. The norm CTAs put their columns' sums of squares and every consumer builds what it reads of x from global memory (in the GDN block at up to 3 rows every CTA computes the rows' rstd itself, cheaper than the hand-off); from 4 (GDN) / 5 (layer) rows, the norm CTAs instead quantize their columns once into a shared MXFP4 image that in_proj_qkvz and the experts copy, as every CTA rebuilding all of x would move 256 × 2 [S, H] bf16 through the L2s each launch.

**MoE.** At decode widths stock runs AITER's `AITER_MXFP4_MXFP4` path with x and silu(g)·u through dynamic MXFP4 (1×32 blocks, RCEIL scales); the layer block does the same, the intermediate quantized where it is produced, and feeds the codes to the scaled fp4 MFMA. From 4 rows the fused shared expert's gate/up runs before the route is known; from 8 rows down starts on the union slots whose gate/up finished in the full rounds, under the last, partial round.

**MXFP4 layouts.** The GDN projections are read in the layout of whichever AITER FP4 GEMM vLLM picked for the shape (`runtime/guards.py`, `mxfp4_shuffled`), quantizing their inputs with the matching rounding (Triton's vs ASM's RCEIL). Both layouts are covered by `test_kernels.py`. No weights are duplicated.

**Refusals.** Config (model `__init__`): an architecture other than `Qwen3_5MoeForCausalLM`, TP≠8, PP, DP, EP, EPLB, DCP, PCP, DBO, sequence-parallel MoE, LoRA, KV connectors, routed-expert capture, speculative decoding, sleep mode, CPU weight offload, weight updates, GDN prefix caching, other GDN cache dtypes, an unfused shared expert, MRV1, `STOCK_TORCH_COMPILE`, other shapes, unnormalized top-k weights, layer scale, non-gfx950 or partitioned GPUs. Model (after load): every layer's modules, quant methods, weight layouts and shapes. Caches (every bind): GDN state dtypes, shapes and slot layout. Without `--monokernel` none of this runs.

**Steps.** `plan()` returns a `Step` for a pure decode of 1–16 rows with int32 GDN state indices, else None (stock forward). Every width is compiled when the executor is built (FlyDSL `COMPILE_ONLY`), so no JIT on the first step of a width. PIECEWISE steps run stock.

**Shared helpers.** The launch ABI and health words, the tagged mailbox with its bounded waits, the build keys, the GEMV stage, peer memory and `FailStop` are adapted from the Kimi-K3 decode (#60683, by @hyukjlee, after ROCm/ATOM), as in #63032, and trimmed to what these kernels use. The package imports nothing from other models; the kernel cache key covers every source under its `mono/`, and the Buildkite step triggers only on this model's directories.

**Limitations / follow-ups.**
- Speculative decoding is refused; MTP verify steps are a follow-up.
- At 4–8 rows the CTAs that run the routed gate/up's last, partial round still own two down row groups each and set the launch's end; moving row groups off them is a follow-up (~3 µs at those widths).
- Failure: every cross-rank wait is bounded (10 s). A rank that gives up records the wait, flags the output rank and sets its sticky failed word; `FailStop` reads that word after each step without blocking and the TP ranks agree every 16 steps, then raise together. There is no fallback to the stock forward after a failure.
- Startup does not check the FlyDSL version.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

@mjkvaak-amd, I think that the GDN projections in this PR should be MXFP6 instead of MXFP4. With the online MXFP4 targets for `in_proj_qkv`, `in_proj_z` and `out_proj`, the gsm8k score stays within noise, but the answers get about 30% longer and about three times as many of them run into the token cap before the answer line. MXFP6 E2M3 brings the answers back to the bf16 length, and K2 reads it as fast as MXFP4.

**Accuracy.** lm_eval gsm8k, 5-shot completions, `max_gen_toks=2048`, 8 concurrent, all 1,319 questions. `amd/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B-Quark-MXFP4` TP8 on MI355X, `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-8cbd5d03006c33185f402249ff2b448efd594986`, the shared expert in online MXFP4 in every row. The standard error of the score is about 0.006, so the answer length shows the difference more clearly than the score.

| GDN projections | Mono decode | gsm8k flexible | Mean answer length (characters) | Answers at the 2048-token cap |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bf16 | off | 0.9492 | 433 | 8 |
| online MXFP8 | off | 0.9560 | 458 | 9 |
| online MXFP4 | off | 0.9424 | 564 | 27 |
| online MXFP4 | on, `6a1c13b2fc` | 0.9477 | 560 | 21 |
| MXFP6 E2M3 | on, K1 and K2 read MXFP6 | 0.9500 | 452 | 9 |

The MXFP6 row also has the attention `qkv_proj` and `o_proj` in MXFP6, so it quantizes more weights than the MXFP4 rows and still keeps the bf16 length.

**How to make the MXFP6 weights.**

1. Serve the GDN projections in bf16, so the targets keep only the shared expert: `--quantization-config.targets '{"*shared_expert*": "mxfp4"}'`. `in_proj_ba` stays bf16 as before.
2. After loading, round every bf16 weight of `in_proj_qkvz` and `out_proj` (and the attention `qkv_proj` and `o_proj`) to its MXFP6 E2M3 value in place, one block of 32 along K at a time. The block scale follows AITER's `dynamic_mxfp4_quant` with the E2M3 maximum of 7.5. The block maximum is rounded to 3 mantissa bits, and the scale is 2 to the power of its exponent minus 2, so no value in the block is above 7.5 times the scale. Each value then rounds to the nearest E2M3 value, ties to even. An E2M3 value times a power of two fits in bf16 exactly, so prefill, the steps wider than 8 rows and K1 and K2 all multiply the same values.
3. Pack a copy for the kernels with the OCP E2M3 codes (sign at bit 5, then 2 exponent and 3 mantissa bits) and one e8m0 byte a block. 32 codes are 24 bytes, with code i at bits 6i to 6i+5 in little-endian order, which is the order in which `v_cvt_scalef32_pk32_bf16_fp6` reads them. One such instruction turns a lane's 32 codes times `2^(e8m0 - 127)` into 32 bf16 values exactly, and they go into the bf16 MFMA with the bf16 activations (W6A16). We store a tile of 16 rows and 128 K as 64 lanes of 24 bytes, with the first 16 bytes of every lane together and the last 8 together, so a lane loads one dwordx4 and one dwordx2. The converted dwords then come out in the order in which K2 reads an MXFP4 tile, so the MFMA loop does not change.

The rounding of step 2:

```python
def round_e2m3(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    v = x.float().reshape(-1, x.shape[-1] // 32, 32)
    amax = v.abs().amax(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    # Adding 2**19 to the fp32 bits of the block maximum rounds its mantissa
    # at the third bit, and a carry moves into the exponent. The mask keeps
    # only the exponent field.
    exp = (((amax.view(torch.int32) + 0x80000) & 0x7F800000) >> 23) - 127 - 2
    # An all-zero block keeps a normal scale, because a scale of zero would
    # turn 0 / 0 into NaN.
    scale = torch.exp2(exp.clamp(-126, 127).float())
    a = v.abs() / scale
    q = torch.where(
        a < 2.0,
        torch.round(a * 8.0) / 8.0,
        torch.where(a < 4.0, torch.round(a * 4.0) / 4.0, torch.round(a * 2.0) / 2.0),
    )
    return (torch.sign(v) * q.clamp(max=7.5) * scale).reshape(x.shape).to(x.dtype)
```

**Cost.** In our build on top of `6a1c13b2fc`, K2 with an MXFP6 `out_proj` or `o_proj` takes 34.7 µs a launch at 2 rows, as fast as with MXFP4. K1 with an MXFP6 `in_proj_qkvz` takes 14.41 µs at 2 rows, against 13.37 µs with MXFP4 and 28.54 µs with bf16, so about 0.07 ms a decode step over the 69 GDN layers. The bf16 weights stay for prefill and for the steps wider than 8 rows, and the packed copies of `in_proj_qkvz`, `out_proj` and `o_proj` add 3.24 GB a GPU. At `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.9` the KV cache goes from 81.44 GiB (7.33M tokens) with the MXFP4 targets to 72.57 GiB (6.53M tokens). A W6A16 GEMM for the stock path would let the bf16 weights go.

- `test_kernels.py`: the GDN block against the Gemma residual add + norm, in_proj, AITER's conv update and fused gated delta rule and `RMSNormGated` at widths 1, 5, 8, 9, 16 (pad rows included, first layer included), on either MXFP4 GEMM layout; the layer block against o_proj / out_proj, the all-reduce, `fused_add_rms_norm`, the router's softmax top-10, the MXFP4 experts with the fused shared expert and the MoE all-reduce at widths 1, 3, 8, 9, 15, 16 (each twice: both epoch parities), on all 8 ranks with rank agreement and the health words left clear. A stalled-rank test launches the layer block on rank 0 only: its waits give up after ~10 s, the failed word and rank 0's flag are set, the given-up waits name only mailbox regions of this kernel, and the next launch returns at once.
- `test_runtime.py` (host side, no kernels launched; skipped off ROCm like `test_kernels.py`): off without the flag, every-reason refusal messages, parallel/feature refusals, the PIECEWISE warning, and `plan()` routing.
- Serving: `--monokernel` compiles 64 builds (92 layers, widths 1–16) at startup, captures FULL graphs, and takes specialized steps.

## Details

**Launches.** Per layer: (1) on the GDN layers, the GDN block: residual add + input_layernorm, in_proj_qkvz (MXFP4) and in_proj_ba, the conv update, the gated delta rule on the cached states, RMSNormGated; on the full attention layers vLLM's input norm and attention run instead, up to o_proj's input. (2) The layer block: out_proj (MXFP4) / o_proj (BF16, with the output gate), the TP all-reduce, the residual add + post_attention_layernorm, the router's softmax top-10 and the shared-expert gate, the MXFP4 experts with the fused shared expert (expert 512), the TP all-reduce. Embeddings, final norm, head and sampling stay vLLM's.

**x without an LDS tile.** At H = 8192 a 16-row bf16 x is 262 KB, more than a CU's LDS, so neither launch holds it. The norm CTAs put their columns' sums of squares and every consumer builds what it reads of x from global memory (in the GDN block at up to 3 rows every CTA computes the rows' rstd itself, cheaper than the hand-off); from 4 (GDN) / 5 (layer) rows, the norm CTAs instead quantize their columns once into a shared MXFP4 image that in_proj_qkvz and the experts copy, as every CTA rebuilding all of x would move 256 × 2 [S, H] bf16 through the L2s each launch.

**MoE.** At decode widths stock runs AITER's `AITER_MXFP4_MXFP4` path with x and silu(g)·u through dynamic MXFP4 (1×32 blocks, RCEIL scales); the layer block does the same, the intermediate quantized where it is produced, and feeds the codes to the scaled fp4 MFMA. From 4 rows the fused shared expert's gate/up runs before the route is known; from 8 rows down starts on the union slots whose gate/up finished in the full rounds, under the last, partial round.

**MXFP4 layouts.** The GDN projections are read in the layout of whichever AITER FP4 GEMM vLLM picked for the shape (`runtime/guards.py`, `mxfp4_shuffled`), quantizing their inputs with the matching rounding (Triton's vs ASM's RCEIL). Both layouts are covered by `test_kernels.py`. No weights are duplicated.

**Refusals.** Config (model `__init__`): an architecture other than `Qwen3_5MoeForCausalLM`, TP≠8, PP, DP, EP, EPLB, DCP, PCP, DBO, sequence-parallel MoE, LoRA, KV connectors, routed-expert capture, speculative decoding, sleep mode, CPU weight offload, weight updates, GDN prefix caching, other GDN cache dtypes, an unfused shared expert, MRV1, `STOCK_TORCH_COMPILE`, other shapes, unnormalized top-k weights, layer scale, non-gfx950 or partitioned GPUs. Model (after load): every layer's modules, quant methods, weight layouts and shapes. Caches (every bind): GDN state dtypes, shapes and slot layout. Without `--monokernel` none of this runs.

**Steps.** `plan()` returns a `Step` for a pure decode of 1–16 rows with int32 GDN state indices, else None (stock forward). Every width is compiled when the executor is built (FlyDSL `COMPILE_ONLY`), so no JIT on the first step of a width. PIECEWISE steps run stock.

**Shared helpers.** The launch ABI and health words, the tagged mailbox with its bounded waits, the build keys, the GEMV stage, peer memory and `FailStop` are adapted from the Kimi-K3 decode (#60683, by @hyukjlee, after ROCm/ATOM), as in #63032, and trimmed to what these kernels use. The package imports nothing from other models; the kernel cache key covers every source under its `mono/`, and the Buildkite step triggers only on this model's directories.

**Limitations / follow-ups.**
- Speculative decoding is refused; MTP verify steps are a follow-up.
- At 4–8 rows the CTAs that run the routed gate/up's last, partial round still own two down row groups each and set the launch's end; moving row groups off them is a follow-up (~3 µs at those widths).
- Failure: every cross-rank wait is bounded (10 s). A rank that gives up records the wait, flags the output rank and sets its sticky failed word; `FailStop` reads that word after each step without blocking and the TP ranks agree every 16 steps, then raise together. There is no fallback to the stock forward after a failure.
- Startup does not check the FlyDSL version.

@@ -0,0 +1,375 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""References for the kernel tests: random weights in the checkpoint's formats
+at the TP8 rank shapes as vLLM holds them after loading, and the ops vLLM runs
+for the same modules (the Gemma residual add + norm, AITER's GDN decode, the
+MXFP4 MoE)."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+bf = torch.bfloat16
+COS_MIN = 0.9999
+
+
+def _on_gfx950() -> bool:
+    if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+        return False
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx950
+
+    return on_gfx950()
+
+
+def _cos(a: torch.Tensor, b: torch.Tensor) -> float:
+    a, b = a.float().reshape(-1), b.float().reshape(-1)
+    return F.cosine_similarity(a, b, dim=0).item()
+
+
+def _rel_l2(a: torch.Tensor, b: torch.Tensor) -> float:
+    a, b = a.float(), b.float()
+    return ((a - b).norm() / b.norm()).item()
+
+
+def _randn(g, *shape, scale=1.0, dtype=bf):
+    return (torch.randn(*shape, generator=g, device=g.device) * scale).to(dtype)
+
+
+def _u8(g, *shape, lo=0, hi=256):
+    return torch.randint(lo, hi, shape, generator=g, device=g.device).to(torch.uint8)
+
+
+def _all_reduce_fp32(t: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The ranks' bf16 partials summed in fp32, as vLLM's custom all-reduce."""
+    t = t.float()
+    dist.all_reduce(t)
+    return t.to(bf)
+
+
+def _gemma_norm(x, residual, w, eps=1e-6):
+    """``GemmaRMSNorm.forward_native(x, residual)`` -> (x, the residual)."""
+    t = x.float() if residual is None else x.float() + residual.float()
+    res = t.to(bf)
+    t = t * torch.rsqrt(t.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + eps)
+    return (t * (w.float() + 1.0)).to(bf), res
+
+
+def _block_input(g, s: int, first: bool) -> dict:
+    """A layer's input: the previous layer's output and residual (bf16, the
+    residual stream larger), the Gemma norm weight (1 + w)."""
+    from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono.layout import HIDDEN
+
+    return {
+        "hidden": _randn(g, s, HIDDEN, scale=0.5),
+        "residual": None if first else _randn(g, s, HIDDEN, scale=4.0),
+        "ln_w": _randn(g, HIDDEN, scale=0.2),
+    }
+
+
+def _mxfp4_linear(gr, n: int, k: int, shuffled: bool = True):
+    """An online-MXFP4 linear (``Mxfp4OnlineLinearMethod``) as the AITER kernel
+    holds it: random fp4x2 (n, k / 2) and e8m0 (n, k / 32); on the ASM FP4 GEMM
+    (``shuffled``) the weight through ``shuffle_weight(layout=(16, 16))`` and
+    the scales through ``AiterMxfp4LinearKernel``'s swizzle, on the Triton FP4
+    GEMM the weight as is and the scales transposed. Returns (raw q, raw
+    scales, w, ws)."""
+    from aiter.ops.shuffle import shuffle_weight
+
+    q = _u8(gr, n, k // 2)
+    sc = _u8(gr, n, k // 32, lo=116, hi=121)
+    if not shuffled:
+        return q, sc, q.clone(), sc.T.contiguous()
+    w = shuffle_weight(q.clone().view(torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2), layout=(16, 16))
+    sm, sn = sc.shape
+    ws = sc.view(sm // 32, 2, 16, sn // 8, 2, 4, 1).permute(0, 3, 5, 2, 4, 1, 6)
+    return q, sc, w, ws.contiguous().view(sm, sn)
+
+
+_FP4 = (0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 6.0)
+
+
+def _mxfp4_dequant(q, scales):
+    """Packed e2m1 bytes (low nibble first) times their e8m0 scales -> fp32."""
+    lut = torch.tensor(_FP4 + tuple(-v for v in _FP4), device=q.device)
+    v = lut[torch.stack([q & 0xF, q >> 4], -1).flatten(-2).long()]
+    return v * torch.exp2(scales.float() - 127).repeat_interleave(32, -1)
+
+
+def _mxfp4_qdq(v, rceil: bool = True):
+    """Dynamic MXFP4 of the last dim as AITER's activation quant: 1 x 32 blocks,
+    e8m0 scale ceil_pow2(amax / 6) (``rceil``: the ASM FP4 GEMM's
+    ``per_1x32_f4_quant_hip``) or 2^(floor(log2(amax rounded at its top two
+    mantissa bits)) - 2) (the Triton FP4 GEMM's ``dynamic_mxfp4_quant``), e2m1
+    nearest even saturating at 6."""
+    b = v.float().unflatten(-1, (-1, 32))
+    amax = b.abs().amax(-1, keepdim=True)
+    if rceil:
+        bits = (amax / 6.0).view(torch.int32)
+        e = ((bits >> 23) & 0xFF) + ((bits & 0x7FFFFF) != 0).int()
+        e = e.clamp(1, 253)
+    else:
+        e = (((amax.view(torch.int32) + 0x200000) >> 23) & 0xFF) - 2
+        e = e.clamp(1, 254)
+    sc = torch.exp2(e.float() - 127)
+    a = (b / sc).abs().clamp(max=6.0)
+    q = torch.where(
+        a < 2,
+        torch.round(a * 2) / 2,
+        torch.where(a < 4, torch.round(a), torch.round(a / 2) * 2),
+    )
+    return (torch.sign(b) * q * sc).flatten(-2)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- gdn
+def _gdn_inputs(
+    s: int, n_real: int, slots: int = 24, shuffled: bool = True, first: bool = False
+):
+    from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono import layout as L
+
+    # live rows on slots 3 .. 3 + n_real
+    slots = max(slots, n_real + 3)
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(0)
+    w = {
+        **_block_input(g, s, first),
+        "w_ba": _randn(g, L.BA, L.HIDDEN, scale=0.02),
+        "conv_w": _randn(g, L.CONV, 1, 4, scale=0.4),
+        "a_log": _randn(g, L.NV, scale=0.5, dtype=torch.float32),
+        "dt_bias": _randn(g, L.NV, scale=0.5),
+        "norm_w": (1 + _randn(g, L.HD, scale=0.1, dtype=torch.float32)).to(bf),
+    }
+    q, sc, w["w_qkvz"], w["w_qkvzs"] = _mxfp4_linear(g, L.QKVZ, L.HIDDEN, shuffled)
+    w["w_qkvz_ref"] = _mxfp4_dequant(q, sc).to(bf)
+    w["shuffled"] = shuffled
+    # vLLM packs a layer's conv and SSM state in one padded page: strided slots
+    n = L.NV * L.HD * L.HD
+    pad = _randn(g, slots, n + 8192, scale=0.05, dtype=torch.float32)
+    w["rstate"] = pad[:, :n].view(slots, L.NV, L.HD, L.HD)
+    conv = _randn(g, slots, L.CONV * 3 + 1024)[:, : L.CONV * 3]
+    w["conv_state"] = conv.view(slots, 3, L.CONV).transpose(-1, -2)
+    # live rows on slots 3 ..; pad rows on the null block 0
+    idx = torch.zeros(s, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    idx[:n_real] = torch.arange(3, 3 + n_real, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    w["st_idx"] = idx
+    return w
+
+
+def _gdn_core_ref(w, n: int, qkvz, ba):
+    """The GDN decode path on ROCm from in_proj's outputs (AITER's conv update
+    and fused gated delta rule, then RMSNormGated with the SiLU output gate) on
+    the first ``n`` rows; the rest are the cudagraph pad. -> (conv state, SSM
+    state, core [S, NV HD])."""
+    from aiter.ops.triton.causal_conv1d_update_single_token import (
+        fused_reshape_causal_conv1d_update_single_token,
+    )
+    from aiter.ops.triton.gated_delta_net.fused_rearrange_sigmoid_gdr import (
+        fused_rearrange_sigmoid_gated_delta_rule,
+    )
+
+    from vllm.config import VllmConfig, set_current_vllm_config
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.layernorm import RMSNormGated
+    from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono import layout as L
+
+    s, nk, nv, hd = qkvz.size(0), L.NK, L.NV, L.HD
+    with set_current_vllm_config(VllmConfig()):
+        norm = RMSNormGated(
+            hd, eps=1e-6, norm_before_gate=True, activation="silu", device="cuda"
+        )
+    norm.weight.data = w["norm_w"].clone()
+    conv_state, rstate = w["conv_state"].clone(), w["rstate"].clone()
+    z = torch.empty(s, nv, hd, dtype=bf, device="cuda")
+    core = torch.empty(s, nv, hd, dtype=bf, device="cuda")
+    mixed, b, a = fused_reshape_causal_conv1d_update_single_token(
+        qkvz.contiguous(),
+        n,
+        nk,
+        nv,
+        hd,
+        hd,
+        ba.contiguous(),
+        z,
+        core,
+        conv_state,
+        w["conv_w"].view(-1, 4),
+        None,
+        "silu",
+        conv_state_indices=w["st_idx"][:n],
+        validate_data=True,
+        qkvz_layout="flat",
+    )
+    fused_rearrange_sigmoid_gated_delta_rule(
+        A_log=w["a_log"],
+        a=a,
+        b=b,
+        dt_bias=w["dt_bias"],
+        qkv=mixed,
+        key_dim=nk * hd,
+        value_dim=nv * hd,
+        head_k_dim=hd,
+        head_v_dim=hd,
+        initial_state=rstate,
+        inplace_final_state=True,
+        cu_seqlens=torch.arange(n + 1, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),
+        ssm_state_indices=w["st_idx"][:n],
+        use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel=True,
+        core_attn_out=core.reshape(-1),
+    )
+    return conv_state, rstate, norm.forward_native(core, z).reshape(s, nv * hd)
+
+
+def _gdn_reference(w, n: int):
+    """The input norm, then the GDN decode path on ROCm (MXFP4 in_proj_qkvz,
+    AITER's conv update and fused gated delta rule, RMSNormGated) on the first
+    ``n`` rows; the rest are the cudagraph pad."""
+    x, res = _gemma_norm(w["hidden"], w["residual"], w["ln_w"])
+    qkvz = F.linear(_mxfp4_qdq(x, w["shuffled"]).to(bf), w["w_qkvz_ref"])
+    ba = F.linear(x, w["w_ba"])
+    conv_state, rstate, core = _gdn_core_ref(w, n, qkvz, ba)
+    return {
+        "x": x,
+        "res": res,
+        "qkvz": qkvz,
+        "ba": ba,
+        "conv_state": conv_state,
+        "rstate": rstate,
+        "core": core,
+    }
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- moe
+def _moe_weights(rank: int, device):
+    """One layer's MoE block at TP8 as vLLM holds it after loading the fused
+    shared expert as expert 512: bf16 router and shared-expert gate; the
+    experts' MXFP4 (RI = RIP: no intermediate pad) through ``shuffle_weights``
+    and ``e8m0_shuffle``."""
+    from aiter.utility.fp4_utils import e8m0_shuffle
+
+    from vllm._aiter_ops import rocm_aiter_ops
+    from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono import layout as L
+
+    h, ri, ne = L.HIDDEN, L.RI, L.E + 1
+    assert ri == L.RIP
+    gc = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(7)  # replicated weights
+    gr = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(100 + rank)  # TP shards
+    fp4, e8 = torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2, torch.float8_e8m0fnu
+    w13q, w2q = _u8(gr, ne, 2 * ri, h // 2), _u8(gr, ne, h, ri // 2)
+    w13s = _u8(gr, ne, 2 * ri, h // 32, lo=116, hi=121)
+    w2s = _u8(gr, ne, h, ri // 32, lo=118, hi=123)
+    raw = {"w13": w13q, "w2": w2q, "w13s": w13s, "w2s": w2s}
+    w13, w2 = rocm_aiter_ops.shuffle_weights(w13q.view(fp4), w2q.view(fp4))
+    return {
+        "raw": raw,
+        "w_gate": _randn(gc, L.E, h, scale=0.02),
+        "w_sg": _randn(gc, 1, h, scale=0.02),
+        "w13": w13,
+        "w2": w2,
+        "w13s": e8m0_shuffle(w13s.view(ne * 2 * ri, -1).view(e8)).view(ne, 2 * ri, -1),
+        "w2s": e8m0_shuffle(w2s.view(ne * h, -1).view(e8)).view(ne, h, -1),
+    }
+
+
+def _route_and_shared(x, mw, ids=None):
+    """The bf16 router's softmax top-10 (or the experts ``ids``) renormalized,
+    then the fused shared expert as pick 10, expert 512, weighted by the
+    sigmoid (fp32) of the bf16 shared-expert gate logit. -> (weights, ids)."""
+    from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono.layout import TOPK, E
+
+    logits = F.linear(x, mw["w_gate"])
+    probs = torch.softmax(logits.float(), dim=-1)
+    if ids is None:
+        ids = torch.topk(probs, TOPK, dim=-1, sorted=True)[1]
+    wts = probs.gather(-1, ids)
+    wts = wts / wts.sum(-1, keepdim=True)
+    sg = torch.sigmoid(F.linear(x, mw["w_sg"]).float())
+    wts = torch.cat([wts, sg], dim=-1)
+    ids = torch.cat([ids, torch.full_like(ids[:, :1], E)], dim=-1)
+    return wts, ids
+
+
+def _check_route(scratch, region, x, mw):
+    """The kernel's ROUTE: each token's picks a top-10 of the bf16 logits up
+    to ties (the kernel's logit sums round to bf16 in another order, and equal
+    keys go to the lower expert), their weights the renormalized softmax.
+    Returns the picks, so the numerics compare on the same experts."""
+    from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono.layout import TOPK
+
+    s = x.shape[0]
+    off = region[0]
+    words = scratch[off : off + s * 2 * TOPK * 8].view(torch.int32)
+    words = words.view(s, 2 * TOPK, 2)[:, :, 0]
+    ids, wts = words[:, :TOPK].long(), words[:, TOPK:].contiguous().view(torch.float32)
+    logits = F.linear(x, mw["w_gate"]).float()
+    tenth = torch.topk(logits, TOPK, dim=-1)[0][:, -1:]
+    slack = 2 * 2.0**-7 * tenth.abs()
+    assert (logits.gather(-1, ids) >= tenth - slack).all(), "picks not a top-10"
+    assert all(len(set(r.tolist())) == TOPK for r in ids), "repeated pick"
+    want = _route_and_shared(x, mw, ids)[0][:, :TOPK]
+    # a renormalized weight moves by its logit's rounding minus the picks'
+    # weighted mean of theirs: up to two bf16 ulps of the largest pick
+    ulp = 2.0**-7 * logits.gather(-1, ids).abs().amax(-1, keepdim=True)
+    assert ((wts - want).abs() <= want * (2 * ulp + 1e-3) + 1e-5).all(), (
+        (wts - want).abs().max().item()
+    )
+    return ids
+
+
+def _moe_exact(x, mw, ids):
+    """The routed experts in fp32 on the dequantized weights, x and the
+    intermediate unquantized, then the all-reduce."""
+    raw = mw["raw"]
+    ri = raw["w2"].shape[-1] * 2
+    wts, ids = _route_and_shared(x, mw, ids)
+    routed = torch.zeros(x.shape, dtype=torch.float32, device=x.device)
+    for t in range(x.shape[0]):
+        for k in range(ids.shape[1]):
+            e = ids[t, k].item()
+            gu = _mxfp4_dequant(raw["w13"][e], raw["w13s"][e]) @ x[t].float()
+            h = F.silu(gu[:ri]) * gu[ri:]
+            routed[t] += wts[t, k] * (_mxfp4_dequant(raw["w2"][e], raw["w2s"][e]) @ h)
+    return _all_reduce_fp32(routed.to(bf))
+
+
+def _moe_emulation(x, mw, ids=None):
+    """The MoE block with the routed experts as the stock decode kernel computes
+    them (x and silu(g) u through dynamic MXFP4, fp32 accumulation, the route
+    weight after w2), in plain torch; then the all-reduce."""
+    raw = mw["raw"]
+    ri = raw["w2"].shape[-1] * 2
+    wts, ids = _route_and_shared(x, mw, ids)
+    xq = _mxfp4_qdq(x)
+    routed = torch.zeros(x.shape, dtype=torch.float32, device=x.device)
+    for t in range(x.shape[0]):
+        for k in range(ids.shape[1]):
+            e = ids[t, k].item()
+            gu = _mxfp4_dequant(raw["w13"][e], raw["w13s"][e]) @ xq[t]
+            h = _mxfp4_qdq(F.silu(gu[:ri]) * gu[ri:])
+            routed[t] += wts[t, k] * (_mxfp4_dequant(raw["w2"][e], raw["w2s"][e]) @ h)
+    return _all_reduce_fp32(routed.to(bf))
+
+
+def _moe_reference(x, mw, ids=None):
+    """Qwen3NextSparseMoeBlock's decode path on ``x`` through vLLM's ops: the
+    router and shared expert of ``_route_and_shared``, aiter's ``fused_moe`` for
+    the MXFP4 experts, the all-reduce."""
+    from aiter import ActivationType, QuantType
+    from aiter.fused_moe import fused_moe
+
+    wts, ids = _route_and_shared(x, mw, ids)
+    routed = fused_moe(
+        x,
+        mw["w13"],
+        mw["w2"],
+        wts.float(),
+        ids.to(torch.int32),
+        None,
+        ActivationType.Silu,
+        QuantType.per_1x32,
+        False,
+        mw["w13s"],
+        mw["w2s"],
+        None,
+        None,
+        dtype=bf,
+    )
+    return _all_reduce_fp32(routed)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Numerics of the Qwen3.8 specialized decode kernels on MI355X against the
+ops vLLM runs for the same modules, random weights in the checkpoint's formats
+at the TP8 rank shapes, widths the decode runs (1 .. 16).
+
+- The GDN block (one GPU): the residual add + input_layernorm (Gemma), then
+  in_proj_qkvz (online MXFP4) / in_proj_ba -> AITER's conv update and fused
+  gated delta rule -> RMSNormGated (SiLU gate), the residual and the states it
+  leaves behind, pad rows.
+- The layer block (eight GPUs): out_proj (MXFP4) / o_proj (bf16, the output
+  gate) + the all-reduce, the residual add + post_attention_layernorm, the
+  sparse MoE block (softmax top-10, the MXFP4 experts, the fused shared
+  expert) + the all-reduce.
+
+No wait of any launch here gives up (the health words stay zero), except in
+``test_stalled_rank_fails_stop``: a rank whose peers never launch gives up its
+waits within the bound, records them and raises its flag on the output rank.
+"""
+
+import pytest
+import ray
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from tests.models.qwen3_5.amd_specialized_decode.reference import (
+    COS_MIN,
+    _all_reduce_fp32,
+    _block_input,
+    _check_route,
+    _cos,
+    _gdn_inputs,
+    _gdn_reference,
+    _gemma_norm,
+    _moe_emulation,
+    _moe_exact,
+    _moe_reference,
+    _moe_weights,
+    _mxfp4_dequant,
+    _mxfp4_linear,
+    _mxfp4_qdq,
+    _on_gfx950,
+    _randn,
+    _rel_l2,
+)
+from tests.utils import (
+    init_test_distributed_environment,
+    multi_gpu_test,
+    multi_process_parallel,
+)
+
+bf = torch.bfloat16
+TP = 8
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not _on_gfx950(), reason="the Qwen3.8 specialized decode needs gfx950"
+)
+
+
+def _health(device="cuda") -> dict:
+    """One GPU's ``health`` words and an ``alarm`` word (its own, no output rank)."""
+    from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.plan import (
+        HEALTH_WORDS,
+    )
+
+    health = torch.zeros(HEALTH_WORDS + 1, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    return {
+        "health": health[:HEALTH_WORDS],
+        "alarm": health[HEALTH_WORDS:].data_ptr(),
+    }
+
+
+# (1, 1) twice: a width again after others compiled (the JIT globals check)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "s,n_real,first",
+    [
+        (1, 1, False),
+        (1, 1, True),
+        (5, 4, False),
+        (8, 8, False),
+        (1, 1, False),
+        (9, 9, False),
+        (16, 15, True),
+        (16, 16, False),
+    ],
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("shuffled", [True, False])
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_gdn_block_matches_vllm_ops(
+    s: int, n_real: int, first: bool, shuffled: bool
+) -> None:
+    """The GDN block against the Gemma residual add + norm, in_proj -> AITER's
+    conv update + fused gated delta rule -> RMSNormGated on one decode step,
+    the residual and the states it leaves behind, and the pad rows (null
+    block: no state written, zero core); in_proj_qkvz on either of AITER's FP4
+    GEMMs (``shuffled``: the ASM one)."""
+    from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono import blocks
+    from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono import layout as L
+
+    w = _gdn_inputs(s, n_real, shuffled=shuffled, first=first)
+    ref = _gdn_reference(w, n_real)
+    key = blocks.GdnBuild(tokens=s, first=first, shuffled=shuffled)
+    conv_state, rstate = w["conv_state"].clone(), w["rstate"].clone()
+    core = torch.full((s, L.CORE), float("nan"), dtype=bf, device="cuda")
+    res_out = torch.full_like(w["hidden"], float("nan"))
+    scratch = torch.zeros(
+        blocks.scratch_bytes(blocks.gdn_scratch_layout(key)),
+        dtype=torch.uint8,
+        device="cuda",
+    )
+    hl = _health()
+    blocks.gdn_block(
+        key,
+        hidden=w["hidden"],
+        residual=w["residual"],
+        res_out=res_out,
+        ln_w=w["ln_w"],
+        w_qkvz=w["w_qkvz"],
+        w_qkvzs=w["w_qkvzs"],
+        w_ba=w["w_ba"],
+        conv_w=w["conv_w"],
+        conv_state=conv_state,
+        a_log=w["a_log"],
+        dt_bias=w["dt_bias"],
+        norm_w=w["norm_w"],
+        rstate=rstate,
+        st_idx=w["st_idx"],
+        core=core,
+        scratch=scratch,
+        epoch=torch.ones(1, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),
+        **hl,
+        layer=0,
+    )
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    assert not hl["health"].any()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(res_out, ref["res"], atol=0, rtol=0)
+    live = w["st_idx"][:n_real].long()
+    errs = {
+        "conv_state": _rel_l2(conv_state[live], ref["conv_state"][live]),
+        "rstate": _rel_l2(rstate[live], ref["rstate"][live]),
+        "core": _rel_l2(core[:n_real], ref["core"][:n_real]),
+    }
+    assert errs["conv_state"] < 5e-3 and errs["rstate"] < 5e-3, errs
+    assert _cos(core[:n_real], ref["core"][:n_real]) > COS_MIN, errs
+    assert torch.equal(core[n_real:], torch.zeros_like(core[n_real:]))
+    torch.testing.assert_close(rstate[0], w["rstate"][0], atol=0, rtol=0)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(conv_state[0], w["conv_state"][0], atol=0, rtol=0)
+
+
+def _tp_state(rank: int, tp_size: int, device) -> dict:
+    """A rank's launch state as ``Launcher`` builds it: the peer buffer (the
+    output rank's flags in its head), the health words, the alarm word."""
+    from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+    from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono import blocks
+    from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono.abi import PEER_HEAD
+    from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono.layout import MAX_TOKENS
+    from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.runtime.peer import PeerBuffer
+
+    peers = PeerBuffer(
+        PEER_HEAD + blocks.peer_bytes(MAX_TOKENS),
+        get_tp_group().cpu_group,
+        rank,
+        tp_size,
+        device,
+    )
+    peers.bytes.zero_()
+    return {
+        "buffer": peers,
+        "flags": peers.bytes[: 4 * tp_size].view(torch.int32),
+        "launch": {
+            "peers": peers.addresses + PEER_HEAD,
+            "rank": rank,
+            "health": _health(device)["health"],
+            "alarm": int(peers.addresses[0].item()) + 4 * rank,
+        },
+    }
+
+
+@ray.remote(num_gpus=1, max_calls=1)
+def _layer_worker(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+    tp_size: int,
+    pp_size: int,
+    rank: int,
+    distributed_init_port: str,
+) -> None:
+    monkeypatch.delenv("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES", raising=False)
+    device = torch.device(f"cuda:{rank}")
+    torch.accelerator.set_device_index(device)
+    init_test_distributed_environment(tp_size, pp_size, rank, distributed_init_port)
+
+    from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono import blocks
+    from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono import layout as L
+
+    h, ck = L.HIDDEN, L.CORE
+    tps = _tp_state(rank, tp_size, device)
+    epoch = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    mw = _moe_weights(rank, device)
+    gr = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(200 + rank)
+    gc = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(11)  # replicated inputs
+    oq_raw, os_raw, w_oq, w_os = _mxfp4_linear(gr, h, ck)
+    w_oq_ref = _mxfp4_dequant(oq_raw, os_raw).to(bf)
+    # the out_proj Triton FP4 GEMM's layout: the same kind of weight, unshuffled
+    flat = _mxfp4_linear(gr, h, ck, shuffled=False)
+    w_of_ref = _mxfp4_dequant(flat[0], flat[1]).to(bf)
+    w_o = _randn(gr, h, ck, scale=0.02)
+    ln_w = _randn(gc, h, scale=0.2)
+
+    def agree(t, what):
+        outs = [torch.empty_like(t) for _ in range(tp_size)]
+        dist.all_gather(outs, t)
+        assert all(torch.equal(outs[0], o) for o in outs), (what, "ranks disagree")
+
+    # each width twice: both epoch parities
+    for s in [w for w in (1, 3, 8, 9, 15, 16) for _ in range(2)]:
+        epoch.add_(1)
+        # (oq, shuffled): out_proj on the ASM / Triton FP4 GEMM, o_proj bf16
+        for slot, (oq, shuffled) in enumerate(
+            ((True, True), (True, False), (False, True))
+        ):
+            what = ("layer", oq, shuffled, s)
+            key = blocks.LayerBuild(tokens=s, oq=oq, og=not oq, shuffled=shuffled)
+            core = _randn(gr, s, ck)
+            gate = None if oq else _randn(gr, s, ck, scale=2.0)
+            residual = _block_input(gc, s, False)["residual"]
+            w, ws, ref_w = (
+                (w_oq, w_os, w_oq_ref) if shuffled else (flat[2], flat[3], w_of_ref)
+            )
+            scr = blocks.layer_scratch_layout(key)
+            scratch = torch.zeros(
+                blocks.scratch_bytes(scr), dtype=torch.uint8, device=device
+            )
+            out = torch.full_like(residual, float("nan"))
+            res_out = torch.full_like(residual, float("nan"))
+            blocks.layer_block(
+                key,
+                core=core,
+                gate=gate,
+                residual=residual,
+                w_o=w if oq else w_o,
+                w_os=ws if oq else None,
+                ln_w=ln_w,
+                out=out,
+                res_out=res_out,
+                scratch=scratch,
+                **tps["launch"],
+                epoch=epoch,
+                layer=blocks.LAYER_SLOT + slot,
+                **{k: v for k, v in mw.items() if k != "raw"},
+            )
+            torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+            agree(out, what)
+            agree(res_out, what)
+            if oq:
+                part = F.linear(_mxfp4_qdq(core, shuffled).to(bf), ref_w)
+            else:
+                assert gate is not None
+                gated = (core.float() * torch.sigmoid(gate.float())).to(bf)
+                part = F.linear(gated, w_o)
+            o_sum = _all_reduce_fp32(part)
+            x_ref, res_ref = _gemma_norm(o_sum, residual, ln_w)
+            # the kernel's AR sum: the same partials in another fp32 order
+            assert _rel_l2(res_out, res_ref) < 1e-2, (what, "residual")
+            # the MoE on the kernel's own AR sum (xbuf): x as the kernel and
+            # vLLM's fused add + norm build it, from the unrounded fp32 sum
+            xo = scr["xbuf"][0]
+            ar = scratch[xo : xo + s * h * 2].view(bf).view(s, h)
+            x, res_got = _gemma_norm(ar, residual, ln_w)
+            assert torch.equal(res_got, res_out), (what, "residual out")
+            ids = _check_route(scratch, scr["route"], x.clone(), mw)
+            emu = _moe_emulation(x.clone(), mw, ids)
+            assert _cos(out, emu) > COS_MIN, (what, _cos(out, emu))
+            exact = _moe_exact(x.clone(), mw, ids)
+            err = _rel_l2(out, exact)
+            err_stock = _rel_l2(_moe_reference(x.clone(), mw, ids), exact)
+            assert err < 1.02 * err_stock, (what, err, err_stock)
+    assert not tps["launch"]["health"].any() and not tps["flags"].any()
+    tps["buffer"].close()
+
+
+@multi_gpu_test(num_gpus=TP)
+def test_layer_tp8_matches_vllm_ops(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    multi_process_parallel(monkeypatch, TP, 1, _layer_worker)
+
+
+@ray.remote(num_gpus=1, max_calls=1)
+def _stall_worker(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+    tp_size: int,
+    pp_size: int,
+    rank: int,
+    distributed_init_port: str,
+) -> None:
+    import time
+
+    monkeypatch.delenv("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES", raising=False)
+    device = torch.device(f"cuda:{rank}")
+    torch.accelerator.set_device_index(device)
+    init_test_distributed_environment(tp_size, pp_size, rank, distributed_init_port)
+
+    from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+    from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono import blocks
+    from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono import layout as L
+    from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono.abi import (
+        FAILED,
+        WAIT_SECONDS,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.debug import (
+        given_up_waits,
+    )
+
+    tps = _tp_state(rank, tp_size, device)
+    health = tps["launch"]["health"]
+    key = blocks.LayerBuild(tokens=1, oq=False, og=True)
+    mw = _moe_weights(rank, device)
+    g = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(rank)
+    scratch = torch.zeros(
+        blocks.scratch_bytes(blocks.layer_scratch_layout(key)),
+        dtype=torch.uint8,
+        device=device,
+    )
+
+    def launch_alone() -> float:
+        """The layer block on this rank only: its peers never send partials."""
+        t0 = time.monotonic()
+        residual = _randn(g, 1, L.HIDDEN)
+        blocks.layer_block(
+            key,
+            core=_randn(g, 1, L.CORE),
+            gate=_randn(g, 1, L.CORE),
+            residual=residual,
+            w_o=_randn(g, L.HIDDEN, L.CORE, scale=0.02),
+            ln_w=_randn(g, L.HIDDEN, scale=0.2),
+            out=torch.empty_like(residual),
+            res_out=torch.empty_like(residual),
+            scratch=scratch,
+            **tps["launch"],
+            epoch=torch.ones(1, dtype=torch.int32, device=device),
+            layer=blocks.LAYER_SLOT,
+            **{k: v for k, v in mw.items() if k != "raw"},
+        )
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+        return time.monotonic() - t0
+
+    if rank == 0:
+        took = launch_alone()
+        assert WAIT_SECONDS * 0.9 < took < WAIT_SECONDS * 6, took
+        assert health[FAILED] != 0
+        # the norm CTAs give up on the peers' partials, the CTAs after them on
+        # this rank's mailboxes the norm CTAs never filled
+        names = (*blocks.PEER_REGIONS, *blocks.LAYER_REGIONS)
+        waits = given_up_waits(health.cpu(), names)
+        assert waits and all(any(f" {r} pair " in w for r in names) for w in waits)
+        assert any(f" {r} pair " in w for w in waits for r in blocks.PEER_REGIONS)
+        assert tps["flags"].tolist() == [1] + [0] * (tp_size - 1)
+        # sticky: a failed rank's waits exit at once
+        assert launch_alone() < WAIT_SECONDS / 2
+    get_tp_group().barrier()
+    if rank != 0:
+        assert not health.any()
+    tps["buffer"].close()
+
+
+@multi_gpu_test(num_gpus=TP)
+def test_stalled_rank_fails_stop(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
+    """A rank whose peers never launch gives up its waits within the bound
+    instead of hanging: FAILED, a record naming the peer region, its flag on
+    the output rank, and its later launches return at once."""
+    multi_process_parallel(monkeypatch, TP, 1, _stall_worker)

+# Qwen3.8-2.4T specialized decode
+
+`--monokernel` on MI355X/gfx950 runs each decode step of Qwen3.8-2.4T
+(`amd/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B-Quark-MXFP4`) at TP8 as persistent FlyDSL launches,
+two a layer (`runtime/decode.py`):
+
+1. the GDN block (`mono/blocks.py`, `build_gdn`), on the linear attention
+   layers: the residual add + input_layernorm, in_proj_qkvz (MXFP4, its input
+   quantized from the normed rows in global memory) and in_proj_ba, the conv
+   update and the gated delta rule on the cached states, RMSNormGated (SiLU
+   gate); on the full attention layers vLLM's input norm and attention run
+   instead, up to o_proj's input (the fused q / k norm, RoPE and gate split);
+2. the layer block (`build_layer`): out_proj (MXFP4) / o_proj (BF16, the
+   output gate), the TP all-reduce, the residual add +
+   post_attention_layernorm, the router's softmax top-10 and the shared
+   expert gate, the MXFP4 experts with the fused shared expert (expert 512;
+   the intermediate quantized to MXFP4 where it is produced, as the stock
+   kernel does) and the TP all-reduce.
+
+The embedding, the final norm, the head and sampling run vLLM's modules.
+
+Supported:
+
+- TP8 on dedicated, unpartitioned GPUs (256 CUs, one CTA per CU), Model
+  Runner V2;
+- plain decode of 1-16 rows, eager or replayed from a FULL CUDA graph (graph
+  padding rows are inert); PIECEWISE steps, prefill, mixed and wider steps run
+  vLLM's forward;
+- the checkpoint's shapes (`mono/layout.py`, `SHAPES`) and formats: online
+  MXFP4 GDN projections in the layout of whichever AITER FP4 GEMM vLLM picked
+  for the shape (ASM or Triton), quantizing their inputs as that GEMM does,
+  `AITER_MXFP4_MXFP4` experts with
+  `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=1`, a BF16 conv state and an FP32
+  recurrent state with `--no-enable-prefix-caching`. Any KV cache dtype vLLM's
+  attention takes.
+
+## Refusals
+
+Default-deny, in three stages, each reporting every reason in one error:
+
+- config, in the model's `__init__` (`runtime/__init__.py`, `unsupported`):
+  an architecture other than `Qwen3_5MoeForCausalLM`, TP other than 8, PP,
+  DP, EP, EPLB, DCP, PCP, DBO, sequence-parallel MoE, LoRA, KV connectors,
+  routed-expert capture, speculative decoding, sleep mode, CPU weight offload,
+  weight updates, GDN prefix caching, other GDN cache dtypes, an unfused
+  shared expert, the V1 runner, `STOCK_TORCH_COMPILE`, other model shapes,
+  unnormalized top-k weights, layer scale, and a platform other than
+  unpartitioned gfx950;
+- model, after load (`runtime/guards.py`, `model_reasons`): every layer's
+  modules, quantization methods, weight layouts and shapes;
+- caches, at every KV cache bind (`cache_reasons`): the GDN states' dtypes,
+  shapes and slot layout.
+
+The TP ranks agree on every stage, so a rank never refuses alone. Without
+`--monokernel` nothing here runs.
+
+## Steps
+
+`plan()` runs once a forward: it returns a `Step` for a pure decode step of
+1-16 rows whose GDN metadata (identical on every rank) has int32 state indices
+covering the rows, and None otherwise (vLLM's forward runs). Every kernel is
+compiled when the executor is built (FlyDSL's `COMPILE_ONLY`), not on the
+first step of a width.
+
+## Failure
+
+A fault in a launch traps the GPU queue: the worker's wait for the step's
+output fails and the engine stops, no token is returned from that step.
+
+Every hand-off between CTAs and TP ranks is a bounded wait (`mono/abi.py`):
+a wait that gives up after 10 s records itself in the rank's health words,
+raises the rank's flag on the output rank and marks the rank failed, so its
+later waits exit at once and the step runs to its end. `FailStop`
+(`runtime/guards.py`) reads the failed word after every step
+without blocking and the TP ranks agree on it every 16 steps, then all raise
+together and the engine stops.
+
+## Code
+
+`runtime/` owns the refusals, planning, the executor and the KV binding;
+`mono/` owns the kernels and their launchers; `mono/stages/` holds the GDN,
+norm, MoE and GEMV stages the blocks share; `mono/common/` the device
+primitives, the tagged mailbox with its bounded waits, and the build keys.
+The mailbox, peer memory (`runtime/peer.py`), GEMV stage and `FailStop` are
+copies of the Kimi-K3 decode's (#60683, by hyukjlee, after ROCm/ATOM),
+trimmed to what these kernels use, so this package imports nothing of
+Kimi-K3's.
+
+## Toolchain
+
+FlyDSL comes in through AITER (`docker/Dockerfile.rocm_base`). Startup does
+not check the FlyDSL version;
+`tests/models/qwen3_5/amd_specialized_decode/test_kernels.py` checks the
+kernels against vLLM's ops.

+        self, input_ids, positions: torch.Tensor, intermediate_tensors

+        decode = self.specialized_decode

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""The layout every MonoKernel's error words follow.
+
+A rank's health words: a header whose word FAILED is set once any of its
+in-kernel waits gave up (sticky: a failed rank stays failed, and its later waits
+exit at once), then one record a CTA of the first wait it gave up on (flag,
+region id, pair index, tag, seen tag, CTA, clock, pad).
+
+The output rank's flags: one int32 word a TP rank in the first PEER_HEAD bytes
+of the output rank's peer buffer. A rank whose wait gives up writes its word
+there, drains the store, then sets FAILED, so nothing it stores later can
+overtake the flag. The runner reads these words after every step.
+"""
+
+RECORD_WORDS = 8
+FAILED = 0
+PEER_HEAD = 256  # bytes: the output rank's flags, a word a rank
+WAIT_SECONDS = 10  # an in-kernel wait gives up after this long
+
+
+def health_words(ctas: int) -> int:
+    """A rank's health words for a grid of ``ctas``: the header, a record a CTA."""
+    return (ctas + 1) * RECORD_WORDS

+"""The decoder layer's two launches, each persistent, ``BLOCKS`` x ``THREADS``,
+S <= ``MAX_TOKENS`` rows:
+
+    gdn    (a GDN layer's residual add + input_layernorm and ``linear_attn``
+           up to out_proj's input): h (+ residual) -> the residual out, x =
+           norm(h + residual) -> in_proj_qkvz (MXFP4) / in_proj_ba -> conv1d ->
+           the gated delta rule -> the gated norm -> core [S, CORE]
+    layer  (out_proj / o_proj, its TP all-reduce, the residual add +
+           post_attention_layernorm, the sparse MoE and its TP all-reduce):
+           core (x sigmoid(gate)) -> every rank's AR -> h + residual -> the
+           residual out, x -> router, sigmoid shared gate, top-10, the MXFP4
+           experts with the shared expert fused as expert 512 -> every rank's
+           FINAL -> the layer's output [S, H]
+
+Neither keeps x [S, H] in LDS (at 16 rows a bf16 x is 262 KB): the norm tasks
+(CTAs 0 .. NRED - 1) put their columns' sums of squares, and every consumer
+builds what it reads of x from the residual add's inputs in global memory
+(``stages.norm``): the router and in_proj_ba a bf16 K slice, in_proj_qkvz and
+the routed experts the rows' MXFP4 codes, the shared gate a dot product. From
+``GDN_XQ_MIN`` / ``LAYER_XQ_MIN`` rows the norm tasks quantize their columns
+once into a shared MXFP4 image (``xq``) that in_proj_qkvz and the experts copy
+instead: every CTA rebuilding all of x would move 256 x 2 [S, H] bf16 through
+the L2s each launch. A launch's input is a previous launch's output (plain
+loads), except the layer launch's AR sums (``xbuf``), which its norm tasks
+write in the launch.

+NRED = N.NRED  # 64: the norm / final tasks, CTAs 0 ..
+OTASKS = H // ROWS  # 512: o_proj / down row groups, bid and bid + 256
+# in_proj_qkvz: row group 255 - bid, and 511 - bid on CTAs QQ0 ..
+QTASKS = L.QKVZ // ROWS  # 288
+QQ0 = 2 * BLOCKS - QTASKS  # 224
+# in_proj_ba: 2 row groups x 8 K parts on CTAs 0 ..
+BA_PARTS = 8
+BA_K = H // BA_PARTS
+BA_TASKS = L.BA // ROWS * BA_PARTS  # 16
+# the router: 4 row groups of the rank's 64 experts x 4 K quarters, CTAs R0 ..
+R_PARTS = 4
+R_K = H // R_PARTS
+R_TASKS = EPR // ROWS * R_PARTS  # 16
+R0 = NRED  # 64
+RT0 = R0 + R_TASKS  # 80: shared gate CTAs, a token each
+PS0 = RT0 + MAXT  # 96: the fused shared expert's early ug CTAs
+GDN_TASKS = L.NV * NVCH  # GDN tasks a token
+# rows from which x goes through MXFP4 once, on the norm tasks (``N.stage_xq``)
+GDN_XQ_MIN = 4
+# rows up to which every GDN CTA computes the rows' rstd itself (``N.local_rstd``)
+GDN_LOCAL_MAX = 3
+LAYER_XQ_MIN = 5
+# rows from which down runs the slots of run_ug's full rounds first, under its
+# last round (needs the fused shared expert's tasks first: ``ps``)
+SPLIT_MIN = 8
+# mailbox tag slots: gdn ``layer``, layer LAYER_SLOT + ``layer``
+LAYER_SLOT = L.MAX_LAYERS
+
+assert SPLIT_MIN >= PS_MIN and GDN_LOCAL_MAX < GDN_XQ_MIN
+assert OTASKS == 2 * BLOCKS and BLOCKS < QTASKS <= 2 * BLOCKS
+assert BA_TASKS <= NRED and PS0 + L.RI // moe.UG_COLS <= BLOCKS
+assert LAYER_SLOT + L.MAX_LAYERS <= moe.TAG_SLOTS
+
+_STREAM = fx.Stream(None)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class GdnBuild:
+    tokens: int
+    first: bool = False  # layer 0: no residual yet (the residual out is h)
+    eps: float = 1e-6  # input_layernorm
+    norm_eps: float = 1e-6  # the gated norm
+    shuffled: bool = True  # in_proj_qkvz in the ASM FP4 GEMM layout, else Triton's
+
+    @property
+    def xq(self) -> bool:
+        return self.tokens >= GDN_XQ_MIN
+
+    @property
+    def local(self) -> bool:
+        return self.tokens <= GDN_LOCAL_MAX
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class LayerBuild:
+    tokens: int
+    eps: float = 1e-6  # post_attention_layernorm
+    oq: bool = True  # out_proj / o_proj MXFP4
+    og: bool = False  # o_proj's input is core x sigmoid(gate) (full attention)
+    shuffled: bool = True  # with oq: the ASM FP4 GEMM layout, else Triton's
+
+    @property
+    def u1(self) -> bool:
+        return self.tokens == 1
+
+    @property
+    def ps(self) -> bool:
+        return self.tokens >= PS_MIN
+
+    @property
+    def xq(self) -> bool:
+        return self.tokens >= LAYER_XQ_MIN
+
+    @property
+    def split(self) -> bool:
+        return self.tokens >= SPLIT_MIN

+def fp4_scale_shape(rows: int, k: int, shuffled: bool) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    """An MXFP4 linear's scales: [rows, K / 32] swizzled for the ASM FP4 GEMM,
+    else transposed [K / 32, rows] for the Triton FP4 GEMM."""
+    return (rows, QL.scale_cols(k)) if shuffled else (k // 32, rows)
+
+
+def gdn_offset(tokens: int) -> int:
+    """The first GDN CTA: past the norm CTAs while the tasks fit on the CTAs
+    with a single in_proj task, else a full round from CTA 0."""
+    return NRED if tokens * GDN_TASKS <= QQ0 - NRED else 0
+
+
+def _xq_layout(lay, key):
+    """With ``key.xq``: the x rows' shared MXFP4 image (16 B aligned) past
+    ``lay``."""
+    if not key.xq:
+        return lay
+    return lay | pair_layout(
+        [("xq", N.xq_dwords(key.tokens) // 2)], 16, scratch_bytes(lay)
+    )
+
+
+def gdn_scratch_layout(key: GdnBuild) -> dict:
+    s = key.tokens
+    lay = pair_layout(
+        {
+            "msq": NRED * s,
+            "xqf": NRED,
+            "proj": s * L.QKVZ,
+            "qk": s * L.NK * 2 * HD,
+            "onrm": s * L.NV * NVCH,
+            "bapart": BA_TASKS * s * ROWS,
+        }.items()
+    )
+    return _xq_layout(lay, key)
+
+
+LAYER_REGIONS = ("msq", "xqf", "rpart", "sgate", "route", "inter")
+
+
+def layer_scratch_layout(key: LayerBuild) -> dict:
+    """The mailbox regions, then ``xbuf``: the AR sums [S, H] bf16 the norm
+    tasks write for the consumers' x (16 B aligned)."""
+    s = key.tokens
+    lay = pair_layout(
+        {
+            "msq": NRED * s,
+            "xqf": NRED,
+            "rpart": R_TASKS * s * ROWS,
+            "sgate": s,
+            "route": s * 2 * TOPK,
+            "inter": s * KT * moe.inter_pairs(L.MOE),
+        }.items()
+    )
+    lay |= pair_layout([("xbuf", s * H * 2 // 8)], 16, scratch_bytes(lay))
+    lay = _xq_layout(lay, key)
+    return lay
+
+
+def scratch_bytes(layout: dict) -> int:
+    return max(o + n for o, n in layout.values())
+
+
+PEER_REGIONS = ("ar", "rlog", "final")
+
+
+def peer_layout(s):
+    """One parity's peer regions: the o_proj partials, the router logits and
+    the MoE partials of every rank."""
+    return pair_layout(
+        {
+            "ar": TP * s * H // 2,
+            "rlog": TP * s * EPR // 2,
+            "final": TP * s * H // 2,
+        }.items()
+    )
+
+
+def peer_bytes(s):
+    """The peer buffer: both parities' regions at ``s`` rows."""
+    return 2 * scratch_bytes(peer_layout(s))
+
+
+def _peers(peers, rank, epoch):
+    """The peer regions at the widest width, this step's parity half: every
+    rank's and this rank's own."""
+    play = peer_layout(MAXT)
+    half = peer_bytes(MAXT) // 2
+    par = uniform(ld_i32(epoch, 0)) % 2
+    bases = peer_bases(peers, TP)
+    own = load_ptr64(peers, rank)
+    peer = {}
+    for region in PEER_REGIONS:
+        off = play[region][0]
+        peer[region] = [
+            shift(preg(b, off, region), fx.Int64(par) * half) for b in bases
+        ]
+        peer[region + "_own"] = shift(preg(own, off, region), fx.Int64(par) * half)
+    return peer
+
+
+def _xwords(s):
+    """LDS words of the x a CTA holds at once: a bf16 K slice (in_proj_ba,
+    the router) or the rows' MXFP4 codes."""
+    return max(s * (max(BA_K, R_K) + gemv.LDS_PAD) // 2, xq_scales(s, H) + s * H // 32)
+

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- gdn
+_GDN: dict = {}

+
+def qkvz_loads(c, rg, live=None):
+    a = c["args"]
+    return moe.fp4_gemv_loads(
+        c["lane"],
+        c["wave"],
+        a["w_qkvz"],
+        a["w_qkvzs"],
+        rg,
+        H,
+        L.QKVZ,
+        c["shuffled"],
+        live,
+    )
+
+
+@traced
+def stage_qkvz(c, rg, ops):
+    """in_proj_qkvz rows 16 rg .. on the x rows' MXFP4 codes -> bf16 PROJ."""
+    s, tid, lane, wave = c["S"], c["tid"], c["lane"], c["wave"]
+    moe.put_acc(c, moe.fp4q_gemv(lane, wave, c["xl"], H, s, rg, ops, c["shuffled"]))
+    if tid < ROWS * s:
+        r = tid % ROWS
+        j = tid // ROWS
+        v = bf16_round(row_sum(c["red"], r, j))
+        c["put"](c["proj"], j * L.QKVZ + rg * ROWS + r, v)
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+def build_gdn(key: GdnBuild):
+    if key in _GDN:
+        return _GDN[key]
+    s = key.tokens
+    need(1 <= s <= MAXT, f"{s} rows, the kernels take 1..{MAXT}")
+    scr = gdn_scratch_layout(key)
+    nr = -(-s * GDN_TASKS // BLOCKS)
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class XLds:
+        xl: fx.Array[fx.Int32, _xwords(s), 16]
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class GdnLds:
+        qkl: fx.Array[fx.Float32, nr * 2 * HD, 16]
+        vloc: fx.Array[fx.Float32, nr * VCH, 16]
+        ol: fx.Array[fx.Float32, nr * VCH, 16]
+        scal: fx.Array[fx.Float32, nr * 4, 16]
+
+    @fx.union
+    class StageLds:
+        x: XLds
+        gdn: GdnLds
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class Smem:
+        red: fx.Array[fx.Float32, WAVES * 64 * 4, 16]
+        rs: fx.Array[fx.Float32, 16, 16]
+
+    keyed = key_tuple(key, source_digest())
+    name = f"qwen38_sd_gdn_s{s}_f{int(key.first)}_w{int(key.shuffled)}"
+
+    @flyc.kernel(name=name, known_block_size=[THREADS, 1, 1])
+    def kgdn(
+        hidden: Int64,
+        residual: Int64,
+        res_out: Int64,
+        ln_w: Int64,
+        w_qkvz: Int64,
+        w_qkvzs: Int64,
+        w_ba: Int64,
+        conv_w: Int64,
+        conv_st: Int64,
+        cs_seq: Int32,
+        cs_dim: Int32,
+        cs_tok: Int32,
+        a_log: Int64,
+        dt_bias: Int64,
+        norm_w: Int64,
+        rstate: Int64,
+        rs_seq: Int32,
+        st_idx: Int64,
+        core: Int64,
+        scratch: Int64,
+        epoch: Int64,
+        health: Int64,
+        alarm: Int64,
+        layer: Int32,
+    ):
+        _ = keyed
+        tid = fx.thread_idx.x
+        bid = fx.block_idx.x
+        alloc = fx.SharedAllocator()
+        lds = alloc.allocate(Smem).peek()
+        st_lds = alloc.allocate(StageLds)
+        xl, gl = st_lds.x.peek(), st_lds.gdn.peek()
+        mb = Mailbox(step_tag(epoch, layer) - 1, health, alarm, region_ids(scr))
+        c = {
+            "S": s,
+            "gdn": L.GDN,
+            "shuffled": key.shuffled,
+            "ba_of": lambda c, t, h: G.ba_sums(c, t, h, BA_PARTS),
+            "ba_parts": BA_PARTS,
+            "z_gate": G.silu,
+            "goff": gdn_offset(s),
+            "tid": tid,
+            "bid": bid,
+            "lane": tid % 64,
+            "wave": tid // 64,
+            "eps": key.eps,
+            "norm_eps": key.norm_eps,
+            "put": mb.put,
+            "put_bf": mb.put_bf,
+            "poll": mb.poll,
+            "red": lds.red.ptr,
+            "rs": lds.rs.ptr,
+            "xl": xl.xl.ptr,
+            "qkl": gl.qkl.ptr,
+            "vloc": gl.vloc.ptr,
+            "ol": gl.ol.ptr,
+            "scal": gl.scal.ptr,
+            "args": {
+                "res_out": res_out,
+                "ln_w": ln_w,
+                "w_qkvz": w_qkvz,
+                "w_qkvzs": w_qkvzs,
+                "w_ba": w_ba,
+                "conv_w": conv_w,
+                "conv_st": conv_st,
+                "cs_seq": cs_seq,
+                "cs_dim": cs_dim,
+                "cs_tok": cs_tok,
+                "a_log": a_log,
+                "dt_bias": dt_bias,
+                "norm_w": norm_w,
+                "rstate": rstate,
+                "rs_seq": rs_seq,
+                "st_idx": st_idx,
+                "core": core,
+            },
+        }
+        for region in scr:
+            if region != "xq":
+                c[region] = sreg(scratch, scr[region][0], region)
+        if key.xq:
+            c["xq"] = scratch + fx.Int64(scr["xq"][0])
+        src = (hidden, 0, None if key.first else residual)
+        rg = BLOCKS - 1 - bid
+        two = bid >= QQ0
+        qops = qkvz_loads(c, rg)
+        qops2 = qkvz_loads(c, fx.min(2 * BLOCKS - 1 - bid, QTASKS - 1), two)
+        is_ba = bid < BA_TASKS
+        bops = G.ba_loads(c, fx.min(bid, BA_TASKS - 1), BA_PARTS, BA_K)
+        if bid < NRED:
+            N.stage_front(c, bid, src, not key.local)
+        if const_expr(key.xq):
+            if bid < NRED:
+                N.load_rstd(c)
+                N.stage_xq(c, bid, src, key.shuffled)
+            if is_ba:
+                N.x_rows_to_lds(c, src, BA_K, bid % BA_PARTS * BA_K)
+                G.stage_ba(c, bid, bops, BA_PARTS, BA_K, sliced=True)
+            N.xq_to_lds(c)
+        else:
+            if const_expr(key.local):
+                N.local_rstd(c, src)
+            else:
+                N.load_rstd(c)
+            if is_ba:
+                N.x_rows_to_lds(c, src, BA_K, bid % BA_PARTS * BA_K)
+                G.stage_ba(c, bid, bops, BA_PARTS, BA_K, sliced=True)
+            N.x_fp4_to_lds(c, src, key.shuffled)
+        stage_qkvz(c, rg, qops)
+        if two:
+            stage_qkvz(c, 2 * BLOCKS - 1 - bid, qops2)
+        gdn_tasks(c, nr)
+
+    @flyc.jit
+    def launch(
+        hidden: Int64,
+        residual: Int64,
+        res_out: Int64,
+        ln_w: Int64,
+        w_qkvz: Int64,
+        w_qkvzs: Int64,
+        w_ba: Int64,
+        conv_w: Int64,
+        conv_st: Int64,
+        cs_seq: Int32,
+        cs_dim: Int32,
+        cs_tok: Int32,
+        a_log: Int64,
+        dt_bias: Int64,
+        norm_w: Int64,
+        rstate: Int64,
+        rs_seq: Int32,
+        st_idx: Int64,
+        core: Int64,
+        scratch: Int64,
+        epoch: Int64,
+        health: Int64,
+        alarm: Int64,
+        layer: Int32,
+        stream: fx.Stream = _STREAM,
+    ):
+        _ = keyed
+        kgdn(
+            hidden,
+            residual,
+            res_out,
+            ln_w,
+            w_qkvz,
+            w_qkvzs,
+            w_ba,
+            conv_w,
+            conv_st,
+            cs_seq,
+            cs_dim,
+            cs_tok,
+            a_log,
+            dt_bias,
+            norm_w,
+            rstate,
+            rs_seq,
+            st_idx,
+            core,
+            scratch,
+            epoch,
+            health,
+            alarm,
+            layer,
+        ).launch(grid=(BLOCKS,), block=(THREADS,), stream=stream)
+
+    GDN_ABI.check(kgdn, launch)
+    _GDN[key] = launch
+    return launch

+def gdn_block(
+    key: GdnBuild,
+    *,
+    hidden,
+    residual,
+    res_out,
+    ln_w,
+    w_qkvz,
+    w_qkvzs,
+    w_ba,
+    conv_w,
+    conv_state,
+    a_log,
+    dt_bias,
+    norm_w,
+    rstate,
+    st_idx,
+    core,
+    scratch,
+    epoch,
+    health,
+    alarm,
+    layer,
+):
+    """A GDN layer's residual add + input_layernorm and ``linear_attn`` up to
+    out_proj's input: ``hidden`` [S, H] bf16 (+ ``residual``, None with
+    ``key.first``) -> ``res_out`` [S, H] and ``core`` [S, CORE] bf16. Every
+    weight as vLLM holds it after loading (in_proj_qkvz online MXFP4 with e8m0
+    scales, in the layout of the FP4 GEMM AITER picked: ``key.shuffled``).
+    ``conv_state`` [slots, CONV, 3] or a transposed view of [slots, 3, CONV]
+    (strides read); ``rstate`` [slots, NV, 128, 128] fp32, a slot dense, slots
+    strided; ``st_idx`` [>= S] int32, <= 0 a pad row (no state written, a zero
+    core row); ``epoch`` a device int32 bumped once a step, ``layer`` this
+    launch's tag slot."""
+    s = key.tokens
+    bf = torch.bfloat16
+    rows = (s, H)
+    need(
+        hidden.shape == rows and hidden.dtype == bf and hidden.is_contiguous(),
+        "hidden: bf16 [S, H]",
+    )
+    need((residual is None) == key.first, "residual: None for the first layer only")
+    need(
+        residual is None or (residual.shape == rows and residual.dtype == bf),
+        "residual: bf16 [S, H]",
+    )
+    need(res_out.shape == rows and res_out.dtype == bf, "res_out: bf16 [S, H]")
+    need(ln_w.dtype == bf and ln_w.numel() == H, "input_layernorm weight")
+    need(core.shape == (s, L.CORE) and core.dtype == bf, f"core: bf16 [S, {L.CORE}]")
+    need(
+        w_qkvz.shape == (L.QKVZ, H // 2)
+        and w_qkvz.dtype in (torch.uint8, torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2),
+        f"in_proj_qkvz: fp4x2 [{L.QKVZ}, {H // 2}]",
+    )
+    need(
+        w_qkvzs.shape == fp4_scale_shape(L.QKVZ, H, key.shuffled)
+        and w_qkvzs.element_size() == 1,
+        "in_proj_qkvz scales: e8m0, one a 32-block, in the weight's layout",
+    )
+    need(
+        w_ba.shape == (L.BA, H) and w_ba.dtype == bf, f"in_proj_ba: bf16 [{L.BA}, {H}]"
+    )
+    need(conv_w.numel() == L.CONV * L.CONV_W and conv_w.dtype == bf, "conv1d weight")
+    need(
+        conv_state.dtype == bf and conv_state.shape[1:] == (L.CONV, G.SL),
+        f"conv state: bf16 [slots, {L.CONV}, {G.SL}]",
+    )
+    need(
+        rstate.dtype == torch.float32 and rstate.shape[1:] == (L.NV, HD, HD),
+        f"recurrent state: fp32 [slots, {L.NV}, 128, 128]",
+    )
+    need(rstate[0].is_contiguous(), "a recurrent state slot must be dense")
+    need(a_log.dtype == torch.float32 and dt_bias.dtype == bf, "A_log / dt_bias dtype")
+    need(norm_w.dtype == bf and norm_w.numel() == HD, "gated norm weight")
+    need(st_idx.dtype == torch.int32 and st_idx.numel() >= s, "state indices")
+    used = [hidden, residual, res_out, ln_w, w_qkvz, w_qkvzs, w_ba, conv_w, core]
+    need(
+        all(t.is_contiguous() for t in used if t is not None),
+        "a non-contiguous GDN input",
+    )
+    vals = {
+        "hidden": hidden.data_ptr(),
+        "residual": 0 if residual is None else residual.data_ptr(),
+        "res_out": res_out.data_ptr(),
+        "ln_w": ln_w.data_ptr(),
+        "w_qkvz": w_qkvz.data_ptr(),
+        "w_qkvzs": w_qkvzs.data_ptr(),
+        "w_ba": w_ba.data_ptr(),
+        "conv_w": conv_w.data_ptr(),
+        "conv_st": conv_state.data_ptr(),
+        "cs_seq": conv_state.stride(0),
+        "cs_dim": conv_state.stride(1),
+        "cs_tok": conv_state.stride(2),
+        "a_log": a_log.data_ptr(),
+        "dt_bias": dt_bias.data_ptr(),
+        "norm_w": norm_w.data_ptr(),
+        "rstate": rstate.data_ptr(),
+        "rs_seq": rstate.stride(0),
+        "st_idx": st_idx.data_ptr(),
+        "core": core.data_ptr(),
+        "scratch": scratch.data_ptr(),
+        "epoch": epoch.data_ptr(),
+        "health": health.data_ptr(),
+        "alarm": alarm,
+        "layer": layer,
+    }
+    build_gdn(key)(*GDN_ABI.pack(vals), stream=torch.cuda.current_stream())
+

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- layer
+_LAYER: dict = {}
+
+
+def router_loads(c, i, q):
+    """Router task (i, q): the rank's experts 16 i .., K quarter q."""
+    return gemv.loads(
+        c["lane"],
+        c["wave"],
+        c["args"]["w_gate"],
+        c["rank"] * EPR + i * ROWS,
+        R_K,
+        ldk=H,
+        k0=q * R_K,
+    )
+
+
+@traced
+def stage_router(c, i, q, ops, src):
+    """Router task (i, q) on x's K quarter q (``rs`` loaded). Parts q > 0
+    publish fp32 partials; part 0 adds them in part order, rounds to bf16
+    (GateLinear's output) and puts the logits to every rank's RLOG."""
+    s, lane, wave = c["S"], c["lane"], c["wave"]
+    N.x_rows_to_lds(c, src, R_K, q * R_K)
+    moe.put_acc(c, gemv.mfmas(lane, wave, c["xl"], R_K + gemv.LDS_PAD, R_K, s, ops))
+
+    def out(t, r, vs):
+        for p in range_constexpr(TP):
+            c["put_bf"](
+                c["peer"]["rlog"][p], (c["rank"] * s + t) * EPR + i * ROWS + r, vs
+            )
+
+    moe.ksplit_rows(
+        c,
+        c["rpart"],
+        lambda qq, t, r: ((i * R_PARTS + qq) * s + t) * ROWS + r,
+        q,
+        R_PARTS,
+        out,
+    )
+
+
+def _rlog_at(rlog, s, t, e):
+    """Token t's logit of expert e: rank e / EPR's slot of every rank's RLOG."""
+    return (rlog, ((e // EPR * s + t) * EPR + e % EPR) // 2, 1)
+
+
+@traced
+def _x_fp4(c, src, missing):
+    """The routed experts' x (RCEIL MXFP4, as the stock decode MoE quantizes
+    it) -> LDS; ``missing``: the CTA has no rstd yet."""
+    if missing:
+        N.load_rstd(c)
+    N.x_fp4_to_lds(c, src)
+
+
+@traced
+def _x_ug(c, src, xq, missing):
+    """The routed experts' x -> LDS: the shared MXFP4 image (``xq``), else
+    built here (``_x_fp4``)."""
+    if const_expr(xq):
+        N.xq_to_lds(c)
+    else:
+        _x_fp4(c, src, missing)
+
+
+def build_layer(key: LayerBuild):
+    if key in _LAYER:
+        return _LAYER[key]
+    s = key.tokens
+    need(1 <= s <= MAXT, f"{s} rows, the kernels take 1..{MAXT}")
+    scr = layer_scratch_layout(key)
+    max_u = s * TOPK + 1  # distinct experts the step can touch + the fused shared
+    d = L.MOE
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class RouteLds:
+        route: fx.Array[fx.Int32, s * 2 * KT, 16]
+        flag: fx.Array[fx.Int32, E, 16]
+        expert: fx.Array[fx.Int32, max_u, 16]
+        kof: fx.Array[fx.Int32, max_u * s, 16]
+        scan: fx.Array[fx.Int32, WAVES, 16]
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class XLds:
+        xl: fx.Array[fx.Int32, max(_xwords(s), s * (L.CORE + gemv.LDS_PAD) // 2), 16]
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class DownLds:
+        il: fx.Array[fx.Int32, s * KT * (moe.irow(d) // 4 + d.rip // 32), 16]
+        contrib: fx.Array[fx.Float32, (1 + int(key.split)) * s * KT * ROWS, 16]
+
+    @fx.union
+    class StageLds:
+        x: XLds
+        down: DownLds
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class Smem:
+        red: fx.Array[fx.Float32, WAVES * 64 * 4, 16]
+        rs: fx.Array[fx.Float32, 16, 16]
+
+    keyed = key_tuple(key, source_digest())
+    name = f"qwen38_sd_layer_s{s}_o{int(key.oq)}_a{int(key.og)}_w{int(key.shuffled)}"
+
+    @flyc.kernel(name=name, known_block_size=[THREADS, 1, 1])
+    def klayer(
+        core: Int64,
+        gate: Int64,
+        residual: Int64,
+        w_o: Int64,
+        w_os: Int64,
+        ln_w: Int64,
+        w_gate: Int64,
+        w_sg: Int64,
+        w13: Int64,
+        w13s: Int64,
+        w2: Int64,
+        w2s: Int64,
+        out: Int64,
+        res_out: Int64,
+        scratch: Int64,
+        peers: Int64,
+        rank: Int32,
+        epoch: Int64,
+        health: Int64,
+        alarm: Int64,
+        layer: Int32,
+    ):
+        _ = keyed
+        tid = fx.thread_idx.x
+        bid = fx.block_idx.x
+        alloc = fx.SharedAllocator()
+        lds = alloc.allocate(Smem).peek()
+        rl = alloc.allocate(RouteLds).peek()
+        st_lds = alloc.allocate(StageLds)
+        xl, dl = st_lds.x.peek(), st_lds.down.peek()
+        mb = Mailbox(
+            step_tag(epoch, layer) - 1,
+            health,
+            alarm,
+            region_ids((*LAYER_REGIONS, *PEER_REGIONS)),
+        )
+        peer = _peers(peers, rank, epoch)
+        rlog = peer["rlog_own"]
+        c = {
+            "S": s,
+            "TP": TP,
+            "moe": d,
+            "rlog_at": lambda t, lane, i: _rlog_at(rlog, s, t, lane + 64 * i),
+            "rlog_last": (
+                TP,
+                lambda i: (rlog, ((i * s + s - 1) * EPR + EPR - 2) // 2, 1),
+            ),
+            "route_cta": RT0,
+            "tid": tid,
+            "bid": bid,
+            "lane": tid % 64,
+            "wave": tid // 64,
+            "rank": rank,
+            "eps": key.eps,
+            "oq": key.oq,
+            "og": key.og,
+            "shuffled": key.shuffled,
+            "u1": key.u1,
+            "KT": KT,
+            "kof_t": s,
+            "max_u": max_u,
+            "put": mb.put,
+            "put_bf": mb.put_bf,
+            "put_words": mb.put_words,
+            "poll": mb.poll,
+            "red": lds.red.ptr,
+            "rs": lds.rs.ptr,
+            "peer": peer,
+            "xl": xl.xl.ptr,
+            "il": dl.il.ptr,
+            "contrib": dl.contrib.ptr,
+            "rt": {
+                "route": rl.route.ptr,
+                "flag": rl.flag.ptr,
+                "expert": rl.expert.ptr,
+                "kof": rl.kof.ptr,
+                "scan": rl.scan.ptr,
+            },
+            "xbuf": scratch + fx.Int64(scr["xbuf"][0]),
+            "xq": scratch + fx.Int64(scr["xq"][0] if key.xq else 0),
+            "args": {
+                "core": core,
+                "gate": gate,
+                "residual": residual,
+                "w_o": w_o,
+                "w_os": w_os,
+                "ln_w": ln_w,
+                "w_gate": w_gate,
+                "w_sg": w_sg,
+                "w13": w13,
+                "w13s": w13s,
+                "w2": w2,
+                "w2s": w2s,
+                "out": out,
+                "res_out": res_out,
+            },
+        }
+        for region in LAYER_REGIONS:
+            c[region] = sreg(scratch, scr[region][0], region)
