+        is_r = (bid >= R0) & (bid < RT0)
+        is_g = (bid >= RT0) & (bid < RT0 + s)
+        ck = L.CORE
+        # ---- o_proj (both tasks' weights in flight first; a router CTA's
+        # router weights behind them), then the AR + residual add + norm sums,
+        # the router and the shared gate
+        if is_r:
+            oops = [moe.o_loads(c, bid + BLOCKS * j, ck) for j in range(2)]
+            ri = bid - R0
+            rops = router_loads(c, ri // R_PARTS, ri % R_PARTS)
+            moe.run_oproj(c, oops, ck)
+            N.load_rstd(c)
+            stage_router(c, ri // R_PARTS, ri % R_PARTS, rops, src)
+        if ~is_r:

+            if const_expr(key.xq):

+            N.load_rstd(c)

+        missing = ~(is_r | is_g)
+        nu = moe.run_ug(c, key.ps, PS0, lambda: _x_ug(c, src, key.xq, missing))
+        dops = moe.down_loads(c, bid, nu, fx.min(c["wave"], nu - 1))
+        if const_expr(key.split):
+            cut = moe.early_slots(c, nu)

+            b2 = bid + BLOCKS
+            moe.down_zero(c, 2)
+            dops = moe.down_slots(c, bid, nu, dops, 0, cut, (b2, 0, cut))
+            dops = moe.down_slots(c, b2, nu, dops, 0, cut, (bid, cut, nu), 1)

+            dops = moe.down_slots(c, bid, nu, dops, cut, nu, (b2, cut, nu))

+            moe.down_put(c, b2, 1)

+            moe.load_inter(c)
+            dops2 = moe.stage_down(c, bid, nu, dops, bid + BLOCKS)
+            moe.stage_down(c, bid + BLOCKS, nu, dops2)

+    @flyc.jit
+    def launch(
+        core: Int64,
+        gate: Int64,
+        residual: Int64,
+        w_o: Int64,
+        w_os: Int64,
+        ln_w: Int64,
+        w_gate: Int64,
+        w_sg: Int64,
+        w13: Int64,
+        w13s: Int64,
+        w2: Int64,
+        w2s: Int64,
+        out: Int64,
+        res_out: Int64,
+        scratch: Int64,
+        peers: Int64,
+        rank: Int32,
+        epoch: Int64,
+        health: Int64,
+        alarm: Int64,
+        layer: Int32,
+        stream: fx.Stream = _STREAM,
+    ):
+        _ = keyed
+        klayer(
+            core,
+            gate,
+            residual,
+            w_o,
+            w_os,
+            ln_w,
+            w_gate,
+            w_sg,
+            w13,
+            w13s,
+            w2,
+            w2s,
+            out,
+            res_out,
+            scratch,
+            peers,
+            rank,
+            epoch,
+            health,
+            alarm,
+            layer,

+    _LAYER[key] = launch

+def layer_block(
+    key: LayerBuild,
+    *,
+    core,
+    residual,
+    w_o,
+    ln_w,
+    w_gate,
+    w_sg,
+    w13,
+    w13s,
+    w2,
+    w2s,
+    out,
+    res_out,
+    scratch,
+    peers,
+    rank,
+    epoch,
+    health,
+    alarm,
+    layer,
+    w_os=None,
+    gate=None,
+):
+    """out_proj / o_proj and its TP all-reduce, the residual add +
+    post_attention_layernorm, the sparse MoE and its TP all-reduce: ``core``
+    [S, CORE] bf16 (x sigmoid(``gate``) with ``key.og``) and ``residual`` [S,
+    H] -> ``res_out`` (the sum over the ranks + residual) and ``out`` (the
+    MoE's output) [S, H] bf16. ``w_o`` as vLLM holds it after loading
+    (``key.oq``: fp4x2 with e8m0 ``w_os``, in the layout of the FP4 GEMM
+    AITER picked: ``key.shuffled``); the routed experts as the
+    AITER_MXFP4_MXFP4 backend holds them (shuffled, e8m0 scales), the shared
+    expert fused as expert 512."""
+    s = key.tokens
+    k = L.CORE
+    bf = torch.bfloat16
+    fp4s = (torch.uint8, torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2)
+    ne = E + 1
+    rows = (s, H)
+    need(core.shape == (s, k) and core.dtype == bf, f"core: bf16 [{s}, {k}]")
+    need(
+        (gate is not None) == key.og and (gate is None or gate.shape == core.shape),
+        "gate: core's shape, with og only",
+    )
+    for name, t in (("residual", residual), ("out", out), ("res_out", res_out)):
+        need(t.shape == rows and t.dtype == bf, f"{name}: bf16 [S, H]")
+    need(ln_w.dtype == bf and ln_w.numel() == H, "post_attention_layernorm weight")
+    if key.oq:
+        need(
+            w_o.shape == (H, k // 2)
+            and w_os is not None
+            and w_os.shape == fp4_scale_shape(H, k, key.shuffled)
+            and w_os.element_size() == 1,
+            f"o_proj: fp4x2 [{H}, {k // 2}] + e8m0 scales in its layout",
+        )
+    else:
+        need(w_o.shape == (H, k) and w_o.dtype == bf, f"o_proj: bf16 [{H}, {k}]")
+    need(w_gate.shape == (E, H) and w_sg.numel() == H, "router shape")
+    need(all(t.dtype == bf for t in (w_gate, w_sg)), "router weights: bf16")
+    need(
+        w13.shape == (ne, 2 * L.RIP, H // 2) and w13.dtype in fp4s,
+        f"w13: fp4x2 [{ne}, {2 * L.RIP}, {H // 2}]",
+    )
+    need(
+        w2.shape == (ne, H, L.RIP // 2) and w2.dtype in fp4s,
+        f"w2: fp4x2 [{ne}, {H}, {L.RIP // 2}]",
+    )
+    need(
+        w13s.numel() == ne * 2 * L.RIP * QL.scale_cols(H) and w13s.element_size() == 1,
+        "w13 scales: e8m0, one a 32-block, shuffled",
+    )
+    need(
+        w2s.numel() == ne * H * QL.scale_cols(L.RIP) and w2s.element_size() == 1,
+        "w2 scales: e8m0, one a 32-block, shuffled (K blocks padded to 8)",
+    )
+    used = [core, gate, residual, w_o, w_os, ln_w, w_gate, w_sg, w13, w13s, w2, w2s]
+    used += [out, res_out]
+    need(
+        all(t.is_contiguous() for t in used if t is not None), "a non-contiguous input"
+    )
+    vals = {
+        "core": core.data_ptr(),
+        "gate": 0 if gate is None else gate.data_ptr(),
+        "residual": residual.data_ptr(),
+        "w_o": w_o.data_ptr(),
+        "w_os": w_os.data_ptr() if key.oq else 0,
+        "ln_w": ln_w.data_ptr(),
+        "w_gate": w_gate.data_ptr(),
+        "w_sg": w_sg.data_ptr(),
+        "w13": w13.data_ptr(),
+        "w13s": w13s.data_ptr(),
+        "w2": w2.data_ptr(),
+        "w2s": w2s.data_ptr(),
+        "out": out.data_ptr(),
+        "res_out": res_out.data_ptr(),
+        "scratch": scratch.data_ptr(),
+        "peers": peers.data_ptr(),
+        "rank": rank,
+        "epoch": epoch.data_ptr(),
+        "health": health.data_ptr(),
+        "alarm": alarm,
+        "layer": layer,
+    }
+    build_layer(key)(*LAYER_ABI.pack(vals), stream=torch.cuda.current_stream())

+"""Wait records: which mailbox region a CTA's given-up wait was on."""
+
+import zlib
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono.abi import RECORD_WORDS
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.plan import BLOCKS
+
+
+def region_id(name: str) -> int:
+    """A mailbox region's id in a wait record: its name's CRC-32 (31 bits), the
+    same in every kernel and table that names it."""
+    return zlib.crc32(name.encode()) & 0x7FFFFFFF
+
+
+def region_ids(names) -> dict[str, int]:
+    """Name -> ``region_id``: a ``Mailbox``'s table."""
+    return {n: region_id(n) for n in names}
+
+
+def given_up_waits(health: torch.Tensor, names) -> list[str]:
+    """Each CTA's first wait that gave up, the earliest first, from a rank's
+    ``health`` words; ``names`` the regions a record may name."""
+    by_id = {region_id(n): n for n in names}
+    records = health.view(BLOCKS + 1, RECORD_WORDS)[1:]
+    records = records[records[:, 0] != 0].tolist()
+    t0 = min((r[6] for r in records), default=0)
+    return [
+        f"+{(at - t0) / 100:.0f} us CTA {cta}: {by_id.get(rid, rid)} pair {idx}"
+        f" waited for tag {tag}, saw {seen}"
+        for _, rid, idx, tag, seen, cta, at, _ in sorted(records, key=lambda r: r[6])
+    ]

+"""Device-side primitives of the mono kernels: wave reductions and shuffles, the
+approximate hardware math, bf16 packing, buffer resources, the
+execution-model constants and the kernel symbol naming.
+
+Ported from the FlyDSL GLM-5 layer kernel (ROCm/FlyDSL branch
+``glm5-mla-moe-layer-monokernel`` @ 1e28fd8a,
+``kernels/mla_moe_layer/shared_reuse_moe_kernel.py``). Only published flydsl APIs
+and aiter's vendored ``buffer_ops`` / ``dpp_utils`` are used.
+
+Every function but ``kernel_symbol`` is traced inside a ``@flyc.kernel`` body.
+
+Raw boundaries kept, for want of an equivalent on the pinned FlyDSL:
+``buffer_ops`` loads / stores (the kernels take raw Int64 addresses, no tensors
+for ``make_buffer_tensor``); raw MFMA intrinsics (hand-laid operands: permlane
+transposes, MXFP4 scales); the LLVM intrinsics here
+(``s_memrealtime``, the approximate rsq / exp2) and the struct unpacking of
+``permlane*_swap``.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels.dpp_utils import update_dpp_i32
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels.kernels_common import kernel_signature
+from flydsl._mlir.dialects import llvm
+from flydsl.compiler.ast_rewriter import ASTRewriter
+from flydsl.expr import gpu, range_constexpr, rocdl
+from flydsl.expr import math as fmath
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T, as_ir_value
+
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.plan import THREADS, WAVES
+
+# gfx95x cache policy bits (LLVM CPol): SC0 = 1, SC1 = 16. SC1 alone is device
+# scope (past the per-XCD caches); SC0 | SC1 is system scope (peers over XGMI).
+CM_DEV = 16
+
+
+CM_SYS = 17
+
+
+# NT = 2: nontemporal. A weight a layer reads once streams past the caches it
+# would only evict the step's reused data from (K2b at 48 rows: 143 -> 133 us)
+CM_NT = 2
+
+
+def kernel_symbol(stem, **params):
+    """Kernel symbol that profilers demangle to ``atom::<stem>_<params>``. The
+    amdhsa assembler rejects ``::`` in a symbol, so it is Itanium-mangled, as
+    aiter's ``_ZN5aiter...E`` kernels are."""
+    name = f"{stem}_{kernel_signature(**params)}"
+    return f"_ZN4atom{len(name)}{name}E"
+
+
+def rsrc(addr, nbytes=None):
+    return bo.create_buffer_resource_from_addr(addr, num_records_bytes=nbytes)
+
+
+def permlane_swap(off, x, y):
+    """v_permlane{32,16}_swap on registers (x, y): off 32 trades x's upper-half
+    lanes with y's lower-half lanes; off 16 trades x's odd 16-lane rows with y's
+    even rows (each within its half). -> (x', y')."""
+    swap = rocdl.permlane32_swap if off == 32 else rocdl.permlane16_swap
+    pr = swap(
+        llvm.StructType.get_literal([T.i32, T.i32]),
+        as_ir_value(fx.Int32(x)),
+        as_ir_value(fx.Int32(y)),
+        False,
+        False,
+    )
+    return tuple(fx.Int32(llvm.extractvalue(T.i32, pr, [j])) for j in range(2))
+
+
+def lane_gather(v, src_lane):
+    """Lane ``src_lane``'s value of v, a source lane a lane (ds_bpermute)."""
+    return fx.Int32(
+        rocdl.ds_bpermute(T.i32, fx.Int32(src_lane) * 4, fx.Int32(v).ir_value())
+    )
+
+
+def readlane(v, src_lane):
+    """Lane ``src_lane``'s value of v (wave-uniform)."""
+    bits = v.bitcast(fx.Int32) if isinstance(v, fx.Float32) else fx.Int32(v)
+    r = fx.Int32(rocdl.readlane(T.i32, bits, fx.Int32(src_lane)))
+    return r.bitcast(fx.Float32) if isinstance(v, fx.Float32) else r
+
+
+def memrealtime():
+    """s_memrealtime: the 100 MHz device clock (no FlyDSL wrapper)."""
+    return fx.Int64(llvm.call_intrinsic(T.i64, "llvm.amdgcn.s.memrealtime", [], [], []))
+
+
+def uniform(v):
+    return fx.Int32(rocdl.readfirstlane(T.i32, fx.Int32(v).ir_value()))
+
+
+def _hw_f32(name, x):
+    return fx.Float32(
+        llvm.call_intrinsic(T.f32, name, [fx.Float32(x).ir_value()], [], [])
+    )
+
+
+def hw_rsq(x):
+    """v_rsq_f32 (~1 ulp, no libm range fixups)."""
+    return _hw_f32("llvm.amdgcn.rsq.f32", x)
+
+
+def hw_exp2(x):
+    return _hw_f32("llvm.amdgcn.exp2.f32", x)
+

+def div_rn(x, d, r):
+    """``x / d`` rounded to nearest, bit-identical to the IEEE division, given
+    ``r = 1.0 / d`` from one true division per divisor (Markstein: a quotient
+    within 1 ulp plus its exact fma residual times RN(1/d) rounds correctly)."""
+    q = x * r
+    return fx.Float32(fmath.fma(fx.Float32(fmath.fma(-q, d, x)), r, q))

+def xshfl(v, off):

+    offsets via DPP (VALU latency, not LDS). Powers of two only: any other
+    offset would take the lane ^ 1 path."""
+    assert off in (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32), off
+    if off >= 16:
+        return v.shuffle_xor(off, 64)
+    is_f = isinstance(v, fx.Float32)
+    x = v.bitcast(fx.Int32) if is_f else fx.Int32(v)
+    if off == 8:
+        y = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(x, x, 0x118, 0xF, 0xC, False))
+        y = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(y, x, 0x108, 0xF, 0x3, False))
+    elif off == 4:
+        y = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(x, x, 0x114, 0xF, 0xA, False))
+        y = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(y, x, 0x104, 0xF, 0x5, False))
+    elif off == 2:
+        y = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(x, x, 0x4E, 0xF, 0xF, False))
+    else:
+        y = fx.Int32(update_dpp_i32(x, x, 0xB1, 0xF, 0xF, False))
+    return y.bitcast(fx.Float32) if is_f else y
+
+
+def xred(v, off, op):
+    """op(v, lane ^ off) for a symmetric op; 32 / 16 take both halves of one swap."""
+    if off < 16:
+        return op(v, xshfl(v, off))
+    is_f = isinstance(v, fx.Float32)
+    x = v.bitcast(fx.Int32) if is_f else fx.Int32(v)
+    a, b = permlane_swap(off, x, x)
+    if is_f:
+        return op(a.bitcast(fx.Float32), b.bitcast(fx.Float32))
+    return op(type(v)(a), type(v)(b))
+
+
+def _add(a, b):
+    return a + b
+
+
+def butterfly(v, offsets, op=_add):
+    """Butterfly reduction over the given xor offsets, in the given order.
+
+    The order is the numerical contract: the aiter per-head norm reduces 32
+    lanes with offsets 16, 8, 4, 2, 1, and matching it keeps rstd bit-exact."""
+    for off in offsets:
+        v = xred(v, off, op)
+    return v
+
+
+def wave_sum(v):
+    return butterfly(v, (32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1))
+
+
+def traced(fn):
+    """Apply flydsl's AST rewriting to a helper, so its ``while`` / ``if`` over
+    traced values lower to scf ops. Kernels rewrite only their own body."""
+    return ASTRewriter.transform(fn)
+
+
+def wave_max(v):
+    return butterfly(v, (32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1), fx.max)
+
+
+def row_shr(v, lane, k):
+    """DPP row_shr:k of an f32: lane - k of the same 16-lane row, else 0."""
+    moved = lane_gather(v.bitcast(fx.Int32), fx.max(lane - k, 0)).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+    return fx.Float32((lane % 16 >= k).select(moved, fx.Float32(0.0)))
+
+
+def _xpartner(v, off, lane):
+    """Lane ``lane ^ off``'s v: DPP within a row, v_permlane*_swap across rows
+    (``xshfl`` takes ``shuffle_xor`` there)."""
+    if off < 16:
+        return xshfl(v, off)
+    a, b = permlane_swap(off, v, v)
+    return ((lane & off) != 0).select(a, b)
+
+
+def wave_incl_scan(v, lane):
+    """Inclusive prefix sum of an Int32 over the wave, in lane order."""
+    blk = v
+    for off in (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32):
+        o = _xpartner(blk, off, lane)
+        v = v + ((lane & off) != 0).select(o, 0)
+        blk = blk + o
+    return v
+
+
+@traced
+def block_excl_scan(v, lane, wave, buf):
+    """(exclusive prefix of v over the CTA in thread order, CTA total); ``buf``
+    needs WAVES words."""
+    incl = wave_incl_scan(v, lane)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    if lane == 63:
+        fx.ptr_store(incl, buf + wave)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    off = fx.Int32(0)
+    tot = fx.Int32(0)
+    for w in range_constexpr(WAVES):
+        cnt = fx.ptr_load(buf + w)
+        off = off + (w < wave).select(cnt, 0)
+        tot = tot + cnt
+    return incl - v + off, tot
+
+
+def ld_i32(ptr, i):
+    """Word ``i`` of a buffer, a plain Int32 load."""
+    return fx.Int32(bo.buffer_load(rsrc(ptr), i, vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32))
+
+
+def ld_dev(ptr, i, words=1):
+    """``words`` i32 (1, 2 or 4) of a buffer from word ``i``, at device scope
+    (past the per-XCD L2)."""
+    return bo.buffer_load(
+        rsrc(ptr), i, vec_width=words, dtype=T.i32, cache_modifier=CM_DEV
+    )
+
+
+LOAD_BATCH = 4  # rounds of a strided loop whose loads go out together
+
+
+@traced
+def batched_rounds(tid, n, load, use, batch=LOAD_BATCH):
+    """A CTA's strided loop over elements v = tid + THREADS i < n (n a Python
+    int): ``load(v)`` of ``batch`` rounds issued before any ``use(v, loaded)``.
+    A round whose ``use`` stores to global memory keeps the next round's loads
+    behind it (they may alias), so the rounds' loads would go out in series. A
+    round past n loads element n - 1 (in range) and uses nothing."""
+    rounds = -(-n // THREADS)
+    for b0 in range_constexpr(0, rounds, batch):
+        idx = range(b0, min(b0 + batch, rounds))
+        got = [load(fx.min(tid + THREADS * i, n - 1)) for i in idx]
+        for i, g in zip(idx, got):
+            v = tid + THREADS * i
+            if v < n:
+                use(v, g)
+
+
+def rows_to_lds(tid, src, rows, row_words, dst, dst_row):
+    """``rows`` rows of ``row_words`` words (a multiple of 4) read at device scope
+    from address ``src`` -> LDS ``dst``, a row every ``dst_row`` words: 16 B a
+    lane, the loads batched (``batched_rounds``)."""
+    assert row_words % 4 == 0, row_words
+    batched_rounds(
+        tid, rows * row_words // 4,
+        lambda v: fx.Vector(ld_dev(src, v * 4, 4)),
+        lambda v, w: fx.ptr_store(
+            w, dst + (v * 4 // row_words * dst_row + v * 4 % row_words)
+        ),
+    )  # fmt: skip
+
+
+def mfma_bf16(a, b, c):
+    return fx.Vector(rocdl.mfma_f32_16x16x32_bf16(T.vec(4, T.f32), [a, b, c]))
+
+
+def row_sum(red, r, t, waves=None):
+    """Row r, token t of the waves' 16x16 MFMA accumulators (wave w's at ``red``
+    + (w * 64 + lane) * 4), summed in wave order from 0 (``waves``: which, in
+    order; all of them by default)."""
+    tot = fx.Float32(0.0)
+    for w in waves if waves is not None else range(WAVES):
+        tot = tot + fx.ptr_load(red + ((w * 64 + 16 * (r // 4) + t) * 4 + r % 4))
+    return tot
+
+
+def ballot(pred):
+    """The wave's lanes where ``pred`` holds, a bit a lane."""
+    return fx.Int64(rocdl.ballot(T.i64, as_ir_value(pred)))
+
+
+def load_ptr64(table, i):
+    """Entry ``i`` of an i64 table in memory, wave-uniform (each half through
+    ``uniform``): a peer's buffer base, a kernel argument block's pointer."""
+    pw = fx.Vector(bo.buffer_load(rsrc(table), i * 2, vec_width=2, dtype=T.i32))
+    return (fx.Int64(uniform(pw[1])) << 32) | fx.Int64(fx.Uint32(uniform(pw[0])))
+
+
+def bf16_round(a):
+    return fx.Float32(fx.Float32(a).to(fx.BFloat16))
+
+
+def bf16_pair(a, b):
+    """Two f32 -> one f32-typed word holding (bf16(a), bf16(b))."""
+    return (
+        fx.Vector.from_elements([a, b], fx.Float32)
+        .to(fx.BFloat16)
+        .bitcast(fx.Float32)[0]
+    )
+
+
+def bf_lo(w):
+    """The f32 of a packed bf16 pair word's low half."""
+    return (w << 16).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+
+
+def bf_hi(w):
+    """The f32 of a packed bf16 pair word's high half."""
+    return (w & fx.Int32(-65536)).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+
+
+def bf2_f32(w):
+    """Packed bf16 pair word -> (f32 low, f32 high)."""
+    return bf_lo(w), bf_hi(w)

+# atom/mono/plan/layout.py
+# atom/mono/runtime/abi.py
+"""A kernel build's parameters, all of them in FlyDSL's JIT cache key.
+
+FlyDSL keys a compiled kernel by the scalar values (int, float, bool, str, enum,
+tuple) its launcher's closures capture; an object in a closure is not keyed, and
+a parameter used only by build-time Python (a placement table, a layout) is in no
+closure at all. Two builds differing only there would share one binary -- every
+TP rank ran rank 3's kernel once that way. So a build's parameters are one frozen
+dataclass of scalars, ``key_tuple`` turns it into one (name, value) tuple, and the
+launcher references that tuple: every field is keyed, whatever the body uses.
+
+The tuple also carries the model's kernel sources (``source_digest``): FlyDSL
+keys a helper's source only when its walk reaches it, and it does not reach a
+helper called inside a traced function's dynamic loop or branch (the rewriter
+moves those bodies into nested functions it does not scan) nor one outside the
+kernel's directory -- an edit there kept the old binary.
+"""
+
+import enum
+import functools
+import hashlib
+import inspect
+from dataclasses import dataclass, fields
+from enum import Enum
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono.abi import health_words
+
+_SCALARS = (int, float, bool, str, enum.Enum)
+_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def source_digest() -> str:
+    """sha256 of every ``.py`` file of the ``mono`` package, each file's path and
+    contents."""
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    for f in sorted(_ROOT.rglob("*.py")):
+        h.update(str(f.relative_to(_ROOT)).encode())
+        h.update(f.read_bytes())
+    return h.hexdigest()[:16]
+
+
+def key_tuple(key, sources: str) -> tuple:
+    """``key``'s (field name, value) pairs, every value a scalar, then
+    ("sources", ``sources``): the model's ``source_digest``."""
+    out = []
+    for f in fields(key):
+        value = getattr(key, f.name)
+        if not isinstance(value, _SCALARS):
+            raise TypeError(
+                f"{type(key).__name__}.{f.name} = {value!r}: a build parameter must be"
+                " a scalar to reach the JIT cache key"
+            )
+        out.append((f.name, value))
+    out.append(("sources", sources))
+    return tuple(out)
+
+
+# The execution model every mono kernel is written for.
+#
+# One CTA per CU of an MI355X, all of them co-resident -- a spin wait on another
+# CTA can only make progress if that CTA is running, so the runner refuses a GPU
+# with another CU count -- and THREADS threads each.
+#
+
+BLOCKS = 256
+THREADS = 512
+WAVES = THREADS // 64
+
+
+# A kernel's mailbox regions laid out in its scratch or peer buffer.
+
+PAIR_BYTES = 8  # a (value, tag) pair
+# A rank's health words (``mono.abi``), for this grid.
+HEALTH_WORDS = health_words(BLOCKS)
+
+
+def pair_layout(items, align: int = PAIR_BYTES, start: int = 0) -> dict:
+    """``items`` (name, pairs) laid out in order: name -> (byte offset, bytes),
+    each region from an ``align``-byte boundary at or past ``start``."""
+    out, off = {}, start
+    for name, pairs in items:
+        off = (off + align - 1) // align * align
+        out[name] = (off, pairs * PAIR_BYTES)
+        off += pairs * PAIR_BYTES
+    return out
+
+
+# A kernel's argument list, named once.
+#
+# A FlyDSL kernel and its launcher each spell out their positional parameters, and
+# the host passes them by position: an argument out of order is a pointer read as
+# another, silently. ``KernelAbi`` is the one list of names; the build checks the
+# kernel's and the launcher's parameters against it, and the host packs by name.
+#
+
+
+def _python_params(fn) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    """Parameter names of a ``@flyc.kernel`` / ``@flyc.jit`` object's Python
+    function (FlyDSL keeps it as ``_func`` / ``func``)."""
+    py = getattr(fn, "func", None) or getattr(fn, "_func", None)
+    if py is None:
+        raise TypeError(f"no Python function behind {fn!r}")
+    return tuple(inspect.signature(py).parameters)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class KernelAbi:
+    names: tuple[str, ...]
+
+    def check(self, kernel, launcher) -> None:
+        """The kernel takes exactly ``names``; the launcher too, then ``stream``."""
+        got = _python_params(kernel)
+        if got != self.names:
+            raise TypeError(f"kernel parameters {got} != ABI {self.names}")
+        got = _python_params(launcher)
+        if got != (*self.names, "stream"):
+            raise TypeError(f"launcher parameters {got} != ABI {self.names} + stream")
+
+    def pack(self, values: dict) -> list:
+        """``values`` (every name, nothing else) in ABI order."""
+        try:
+            if len(values) == len(self.names):
+                return [values[n] for n in self.names]
+        except KeyError:
+            pass
+        extra = sorted(set(values) - set(self.names))
+        missing = sorted(set(self.names) - set(values))
+        raise TypeError(f"ABI mismatch: missing {missing}, unexpected {extra}")
+
+    def zeros(self) -> list:
+        """Every argument 0: what a compile-only call passes."""
+        return [0] * len(self.names)
+
+
+class Space(Enum):
+    SCRATCH = "scratch"  # this GPU's memory: device-scope hand-off between CTAs
+    PEER = "peer"  # a peer-symmetric region: system-scope hand-off between GPUs

+# atom/mono/device/ranks.py
+"""A TP group seen from inside a kernel: every rank's peer buffer, and an
+all-reduce's sum of the ranks' partials. ``tp`` is a build-time constant."""
+
+from flydsl.expr import range_constexpr
+
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.ops import (
+    bf2_f32,
+    load_ptr64,
+)
+
+
+def peer_bases(peers, tp):
+    """Every rank's peer buffer base from the ``peers`` table (an i64 a rank),
+    loaded once: a put's address must not wait on a load of its own."""
+    return [load_ptr64(peers, p) for p in range(tp)]
+
+
+def sum_partials(poll, own, pair_of, tp):
+    """The ``tp`` ranks' bf16 pair partials at ``pair_of(src)`` of the mailbox
+    region ``own``, summed in fp32 in rank order 0 .. tp - 1: one poll batch ->
+    (lo sum, hi sum). Every rank sums in the same order, so they agree."""
+    ws = poll([(own, pair_of(src), 1) for src in range(tp)])
+    acc0, acc1 = bf2_f32(ws[0][0])
+    for src in range_constexpr(1, tp):
+        lo, hi = bf2_f32(ws[src][0])
+        acc0 = acc0 + lo
+        acc1 = acc1 + hi
+    return acc0, acc1

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+# Adapted from ROCm/ATOM (https://github.com/ROCm/ATOM) at a526f0d, MIT License,
+# Copyright (C) 2026, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.:
+# atom/mono/device/sync.py
+"""The tagged mailbox: hand-offs between the CTAs of one GPU (device scope) and
+between GPUs (system scope), every address a named region (``Addr``)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from flydsl.expr import const_expr, gpu, range_constexpr, rocdl
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T
+
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono.abi import (
+    FAILED,
+    RECORD_WORDS,
+    WAIT_SECONDS,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.ops import (
+    CM_DEV,
+    CM_SYS,
+    bf16_pair,
+    memrealtime,
+    rsrc,
+    traced,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.plan import Space
+
+POLL_MAX = 12  # mailbox specs polled per batch (bounds live registers)
+
+WAIT_TICKS = WAIT_SECONDS * 100_000_000  # s_memrealtime ticks at 100 MHz
+
+
+@traced
+def _spin(load_all, pending, health, alarm, region_id, index, tag):
+    """Re-issue ``load_all`` until ``pending`` clears, for at most WAIT_TICKS, and
+    not at all once this rank has failed (``health`` word FAILED), so a failed
+    step runs to its end instead of hanging. A side-effecting op in the loop keeps
+    the loads from being hoisted.
+
+    A CTA's first give-up is recorded in its ``health`` record; it then raises the
+    output rank's flag for this rank (``alarm``) and drains that store before it
+    sets FAILED, so no later store of this rank's can overtake the flag."""
+    t0 = memrealtime()
+    v = load_all()
+    why = fx.Int32(0)  # 1: timed out, 2: the rank had failed
+    while pending(v) & (why == 0):
+        rocdl.s_sleep(1)
+        v = load_all()
+        failed = ld_health(health, FAILED) != 0
+        late = memrealtime() - t0 > WAIT_TICKS
+        why = failed.select(fx.Int32(2), late.select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0)))
+    if why == 1:
+        bid = fx.block_idx.x
+        rec = (bid + 1) * RECORD_WORDS
+        if ld_health(health, rec) == 0:
+            at = fx.Int32(memrealtime() & 0x7FFFFFFF)
+            record = [1, region_id, index, tag, v[1], bid, at, 0]
+            for h in range_constexpr(2):  # 16 B a store
+                bo.buffer_store(
+                    fx.Vector.from_elements(
+                        [fx.Int32(w) for w in record[4 * h : 4 * h + 4]], fx.Int32
+                    ),
+                    rsrc(health),
+                    rec + 4 * h,
+                    cache_modifier=CM_SYS,
+                )
+        bo.buffer_store(fx.Int32(1), rsrc(alarm), 0, cache_modifier=CM_SYS)
+        rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
+        bo.buffer_store(fx.Int32(1), rsrc(health), FAILED, cache_modifier=CM_SYS)
+    return v
+
+
+def ld_health(health, i):
+    return fx.Int32(
+        bo.buffer_load(rsrc(health), i, vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32, cache_modifier=CM_SYS)
+    )
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Addr:
+    """A mailbox region's address: the region's name (a give-up records its id),
+    its space and the traced address. The space sets the hand-off's scope:
+    device for SCRATCH, system for PEER."""
+
+    region: str
+    space: Space
+    value: object
+
+
+def sreg(base, offset, region):
+    """Scratch region ``region`` at byte ``offset`` of ``base``."""
+    return Addr(region, Space.SCRATCH, base + fx.Int64(offset))
+
+
+def preg(base, offset, region):
+    """Peer-symmetric region ``region`` at byte ``offset`` of a rank's buffer
+    ``base``."""
+    return Addr(region, Space.PEER, base + fx.Int64(offset))
+
+
+def shift(a, delta):
+    """``a`` moved by ``delta`` bytes (a traced or Python integer), same region."""
+    return Addr(a.region, a.space, a.value + delta)
+
+
+# the store / load cache policy of a hand-off in each space
+_SCOPE_CM = {Space.SCRATCH: CM_DEV, Space.PEER: CM_SYS}
+
+
+class Mailbox:
+    """Tagged-pair hand-off between CTAs (device scope) and GPUs (system scope).
+
+    Every 32-bit value is stored next to this launch's tag; a consumer
+    polls the payload until all tags match, so a hand-off costs one round trip
+    (no store drain, no separate flag). The tag is ``layer + 1``: it tells the
+    layers of one step apart, and the runner zeroes every mailbox at a step's
+    start (``StepMailboxes.begin_step``), so a pair from an earlier step never
+    carries a live tag. Every address is an ``Addr``: its space picks the scope.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, layer, health, alarm, region_ids):
+        """``health``: this rank's health words (FAILED, then a wait record a
+        CTA); ``alarm``: this rank's flag word on the output rank;
+        ``region_ids``: region name -> the id a record names it by."""
+        self.tag = layer + 1
+        self.health = health
+        self.alarm = alarm
+        self.region_ids = region_ids
+
+    def put(self, a, i, v):
+        bits = v.bitcast(fx.Int32) if isinstance(v, fx.Float32) else fx.Int32(v)
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            fx.Vector.from_elements([bits, self.tag], fx.Int32),
+            rsrc(a.value),
+            i * 2,
+            cache_modifier=_SCOPE_CM[a.space],
+        )
+
+    def put_bf(self, a, i, vs):
+        """Elements i .. i+len(vs) (2 or 4, i aligned) as packed bf16 pairs, one
+        store."""
+        words = []
+        for j in range_constexpr(len(vs) // 2):
+            words += [bf16_pair(vs[2 * j], vs[2 * j + 1]).bitcast(fx.Int32), self.tag]
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            fx.Vector.from_elements(words, fx.Int32),
+            rsrc(a.value),
+            i,
+            cache_modifier=_SCOPE_CM[a.space],
+        )
+
+    def put_words(self, a, i, words):
+        """Raw 32-bit words (1 or 2) at pairs i.. as (word, tag). Integer payloads
+        (fp8 words) must come this way: through an f32 value a NaN bit pattern is
+        not kept."""
+        vals = []
+        for w in words:
+            vals += [fx.Int32(w), self.tag]
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            fx.Vector.from_elements(vals, fx.Int32),
+            rsrc(a.value),
+            i * 2,
+            cache_modifier=_SCOPE_CM[a.space],
+        )
+
+    def poll(self, specs, batch=POLL_MAX):
+        """Batched poll of pairs ``specs`` = [(Addr, pair index, npairs in {1, 2})],
+        all of one space.
+
+        All pairs are re-loaded together while any tag is stale, so a batch costs
+        one round trip after its last producer lands. Returns the value words."""
+        if const_expr(len(specs) == 0):
+            return []
+        if const_expr(len(specs) > batch):
+            return self.poll(specs[:batch], batch) + self.poll(specs[batch:], batch)
+        spaces = {a.space for a, _, _ in specs}
+        assert len(spaces) == 1, f"one poll batch spans {spaces}"
+        cm = _SCOPE_CM[spaces.pop()]
+        bases = [a.value for a, _, _ in specs]
+        tag = self.tag
+
+        def load_all():
+            words = []
+            for b, (_, i, n) in zip(bases, specs):
+                w = fx.Vector(
+                    bo.buffer_load(
+                        rsrc(b),
+                        fx.Int32(i) * 2,
+                        vec_width=2 * n,
+                        dtype=T.i32,
+                        cache_modifier=cm,
+                    )
+                )
+                words += [w[e] for e in range(2 * n)]
+            return fx.Vector.from_elements(words, fx.Int32)
+
+        nw = sum(2 * n for _, _, n in specs)
+
+        def pending(v):
+            bad = v[1] != tag
+            for e in range_constexpr(3, nw, 2):
+                bad = bad | (v[e] != tag)
+            return bad
+
+        rid = self.region_ids.get(specs[0][0].region, -1)
+        v = _spin(load_all, pending, self.health, self.alarm, rid, specs[0][1], tag)
+        outs, e = [], 0
+        for _, _, n in specs:
+            outs.append([v[e + 2 * q] for q in range(n)])
+            e += 2 * n
+        return outs
+
+
+@traced
+def publish(put, a, i, v, who):
+    """This CTA's plain stores made readable by every CTA, then (thread ``who``)
+    the mailbox pair (``a``, i) := v. The stores are drained first: a flag may
+    not overtake the data it announces, and a workgroup-scope release fence does
+    not wait for them (LLVM's AMDGPU memory model omits vmcnt outside tgsplit
+    mode: the workgroup's waves share one CU, the readers here do not)."""
+    rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    if who:
+        put(a, i, v)

+"""Qwen3.8 (``Qwen3_5MoeForCausalLM``, amd/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B): the shapes the
+kernels are built for, at TP8 (the only TP size they serve), so every shape
+below is a compile-time constant of a kernel.
+
+The routed experts and the online-MXFP4 linears (in_proj_qkvz, out_proj)
+hold the layouts in ``mx_layout``.
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono import mx_layout as QL
+
+BLOCKS = 256  # CTAs a launch, all resident at once: one a CU
+# the rows a launch serves: a step of more rows runs stock
+MAX_TOKENS = 16
+ROWS = QL.ROWS  # a weight row group
+TP = 8
+
+# the model (``Qwen3_5MoeTextConfig``)
+HIDDEN = 8192
+HD = 128  # GDN key and value head dim
+CONV_W = 4
+E = 512
+TOPK = 10
+MOE_I = 2048  # moe_intermediate_size
+ATTN_HEADS = 64
+ATTN_HD = 256
+# the text config's fields the kernels are written for, and their values
+SHAPE_NAMES = (
+    "hidden_size",
+    "linear_num_key_heads",
+    "linear_num_value_heads",
+    "linear_key_head_dim",
+    "linear_value_head_dim",
+    "linear_conv_kernel_dim",
+    "num_attention_heads",
+    "head_dim",
+    "num_experts",
+    "num_experts_per_tok",
+    "moe_intermediate_size",
+    "shared_expert_intermediate_size",
+    "hidden_act",
+)
+SHAPES = (
+    HIDDEN,
+    16,
+    128,
+    HD,
+    HD,
+    CONV_W,
+    ATTN_HEADS,
+    ATTN_HD,
+    E,
+    TOPK,
+    MOE_I,
+    MOE_I,
+    "silu",
+)
+# decoder layers: a kernel's mailbox tag slots (``moe.TAG_SLOTS / 2``)
+MAX_LAYERS = 128
+# the GDN states the GDN block updates in place
+CONV_DTYPE = torch.bfloat16
+STATE_DTYPE = torch.float32
+
+# a rank's shapes
+NK = 16 // TP  # GDN key heads: 2
+NV = 128 // TP  # GDN value heads: 16
+KEY = NK * HD
+VAL = NV * HD
+QKVZ = 2 * KEY + 2 * VAL  # in_proj_qkvz rows: [q | k | v | z]
+BA = 2 * NV  # in_proj_ba rows: [b | a]
+CONV = 2 * KEY + VAL  # conv channels: q | k | v
+CORE = NV * HD  # out_proj / o_proj K (GDN: NV HD; attention: heads HD)
+RI = MOE_I // TP  # routed intermediate a rank holds: 256
+RIP = RI  # as the weights hold it (a multiple of the backend's 128)
+EPR = E // TP  # router logits a rank computes: 64
+MOE = QL.MoeDims(HIDDEN, RI, RIP)
+GDN = QL.GdnDims(NK, NV, QKVZ)
+
+assert ATTN_HEADS // TP * ATTN_HD == CORE and RIP % 128 == 0
+
+
+def need(ok: bool, what: str) -> None:
+    """A launch argument check that ``python -O`` keeps: the kernels read
+    out-of-bounds memory silently where a fault would be wanted."""
+    if not ok:
+        raise ValueError(f"Qwen3.8 specialized decode: {what}")

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The MXFP4 weight layouts the kernels read in place, and the routed-expert
+addressing (``MoeDims``).
+
+Plain integer arithmetic: the same functions index a tensor on the host (the
+layout tests) and build an address from traced values in a kernel.
+
+Routed experts (``AITER_MXFP4_MXFP4``): ``w13`` (E, 2 RIP, HIDDEN / 2) and
+``w2`` (E, HIDDEN, RIP / 2) fp4x2, ``[gate; up]`` rows, each half zero-padded
+from RI to RIP (the backend's 128 alignment), through
+``shuffle_weight(layout=(16, 16))``: a 16-row group's 16-byte K chunks as
+``[chunk][row % 16][16 B]``. Their e8m0 scales through ``e8m0_shuffle`` over
+(E N, K / 32), K / 32 padded to a multiple of 8 (``scale_cols``):
+``scale_index``. The online-MXFP4 linears on AITER's ASM FP4 GEMM hold the
+same layouts, one "expert"; on its Triton FP4 GEMM they are row-major with
+transposed scales (``fp4_row_dword``, ``scale_t_index``).
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+ROWS = 16  # a weight row group
+FP4_STEP = 128  # K a scaled-MFMA step covers (a lane: 32 fp4 of one row)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class MoeDims:
+    """A rank's routed-expert shapes, what the MoE stages read: the hidden
+    size, the routed intermediate a rank holds (RI) and the weights' padded
+    one (RIP)."""
+
+    hidden: int
+    ri: int
+    rip: int
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class GdnDims:
+    """A rank's GDN shapes, what the GDN stages read: its key and value
+    heads and PROJ's entries a token (in_proj's outputs, [q | k | v | z ..])."""
+
+    nk: int
+    nv: int
+    proj: int
+
+
+def fp4_group_dwords(k):
+    """Dwords of one 16-row group of an fp4 weight with K = ``k``."""
+    return ROWS * k // 8
+
+
+def fp4_tile_dword(expert_base, rg, k, st, lane):
+    """Dword of lane ``lane``'s 16 B of 16-row group ``rg`` at K step ``st``:
+    row 16 rg + lane % 16, fp4 K 128 st + 32 (lane / 16) .. + 32. ``expert_base``
+    is the expert's first dword (``e * rows * k / 8``)."""
+    return expert_base + rg * fp4_group_dwords(k) + st * 256 + lane * 4
+
+
+def fp4_row_dword(rg, k, st, lane):
+    """``fp4_tile_dword`` in a row-major fp4 weight (``[N, k / 2]``, the Triton
+    FP4 GEMM's): the same 16 B, row 16 rg + lane % 16 at fp4 K 128 st + 32
+    (lane / 16)."""
+    return (rg * ROWS + lane % ROWS) * (k // 8) + st * 16 + (lane // 16) * 4
+
+
+def scale_t_index(row, kb, rows):
+    """Byte of e8m0 scale (row, K block ``kb``) in a transposed ``[K / 32,
+    rows]`` scale (the Triton FP4 GEMM's)."""
+    return kb * rows + row
+
+
+def w13_base(d: MoeDims, e):
+    """First dword of expert ``e``'s w13 (2 RIP rows, K = hidden). The constant
+    folds first: ``e`` is i32 in the kernel and e 2 RI HIDDEN is 2^31 at e 512."""
+    return e * (2 * d.rip * d.hidden // 8)
+
+
+def w13_group(d: MoeDims, gate_or_up, g):
+    """Row group of w13 holding intermediate columns 16 g .. of the gate (0) or
+    up (1) projection: ``[gate; up]`` rows, each RIP, not interleaved."""
+    return gate_or_up * (d.rip // ROWS) + g
+
+
+def w2_base(d: MoeDims, e):
+    """First dword of expert ``e``'s w2 (hidden rows, K = RIP)."""
+    return e * (d.hidden * d.rip // 8)
+
+
+def scale_index(row, col, cols):
+    """Byte of e8m0 scale (row, col) in aiter's ``e8m0_shuffle`` layout over a
+    (rows, ``cols``) matrix: ``view(rows/32, 2, 16, cols/8, 2, 4)
+    .permute(0, 3, 5, 2, 4, 1)``. ``row`` counts across experts (e N + n)."""
+    r32, a, b = row // 32, (row // 16) % 2, row % 16
+    c8, d, f = col // 8, (col // 4) % 2, col % 4
+    return ((((r32 * (cols // 8) + c8) * 4 + f) * 16 + b) * 2 + d) * 2 + a
+
+
+def scale_cols(k):
+    """Columns of a shuffled scale for K = ``k``: ``shuffle_scale`` pads K / 32
+    to a multiple of 8 (with e8m0 1.0)."""
+    return (k // 32 + 7) // 8 * 8
+
+
+def scale_code_shift(st, rg):
+    """Bit offset of K step ``st``'s code for 16-row group ``rg`` in the dword
+    ``scale_index`` puts it in (its block ``4 st + lane / 16``): byte
+    (st % 2) 2 + rg % 2."""
+    return (st % 2) * 16 + (rg % 2) * 8
+
+
+def w13_scale_index(d: MoeDims, e, n, kb):
+    """Byte of w13's scale for row ``n`` (of 2 RIP), K block ``kb``."""
+    return scale_index(e * 2 * d.rip + n, kb, scale_cols(d.hidden))
+
+
+def w2_scale_index(d: MoeDims, e, n, kb):
+    """Byte of w2's scale for row ``n`` (of hidden), K block ``kb``."""
+    return scale_index(e * d.hidden + n, kb, scale_cols(d.rip))

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The gated delta rule of a GDN (linear-attention) block, on the in_proj
+outputs the block's earlier stages put to PROJ / BAPART (``in_proj``):
+
+    gdn  (S x NV value heads x 8 chunks of 16 state rows, task n on CTA
+         (n + goff) % 256; a CTA runs its tasks phase by phase, so the rounds'
+         hand-offs overlap; from BATCH_ROUNDS rounds it polls each hand-off
+         for all of them at once): the conv update of the owned channels (a key
+         head's q / k by its first value head's tasks, out through QK), the
+         gates, q / k l2norm, the recurrence on 16 state rows (fp32, in
+         place), partial norms (ONRM), RMSNormGated -> ``core``
+
+Rounding follows the stock decode path (AITER's Triton conv update and fused
+gated delta rule, RMSNormGated) where it is elementwise: every conv product
+rounded to bf16 as Triton's bf16 multiply does, the bf16 conv output, the bf16
+core before the gated norm. Split-K reductions differ only in their order.
+
+A row whose state index is <= 0 (vLLM's null block, what the GDN metadata pads
+a decode batch with) writes no state and a zero core row, as stock (its query
+length is 0 there).
+
+A GDN round is 256 consecutive tasks on distinct CTAs; a task waits only on
+tasks of its own round (a key head's 64 tasks, a head's 8 chunks), so no CTA
+waits on work queued behind it.
+"""
+
+import math
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from flydsl._mlir.dialects import llvm
+from flydsl.expr import const_expr, gpu, range_constexpr
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T
+
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono import layout as L
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.ops import (
+    bf16_round,
+    bf_hi,
+    bf_lo,
+    butterfly,
+    hw_exp2,
+    hw_rsq,
+    ld_i32,
+    row_sum,
+    rsrc,
+    traced,
+    uniform,
+    wave_sum,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.plan import (
+    BLOCKS,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono.stages import gemv
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono.stages.moe import (
+    f32_of,
+    rows_at,
+    sigmoid,
+    tiled,
+    tok,
+)
+
+ROWS, HD = L.ROWS, L.HD
+VCH = 16  # state rows a GDN task
+NVCH = HD // VCH  # 8
+SL = L.CONV_W - 1  # conv state entries (no spec decode)
+SOFTPLUS_THRESHOLD = 20.0
+# rounds from which a CTA polls each hand-off for all its rounds at once
+BATCH_ROUNDS = 4
+LOG2E = 1.0 / math.log(2.0)
+LN2 = math.log(2.0)
+
+
+def ld_bf(ptr, i):
+    return fx.Float32(
+        fx.BFloat16(bo.buffer_load(rsrc(ptr), i, vec_width=1, dtype=T.bf16))
+    )
+
+
+def ld_f32(ptr, i):
+    return fx.Float32(bo.buffer_load(rsrc(ptr), i, vec_width=1, dtype=T.f32))
+
+
+def hw_log2(x):
+    return fx.Float32(
+        llvm.call_intrinsic(
+            T.f32, "llvm.amdgcn.log.f32", [fx.Float32(x).ir_value()], [], []
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def hw_exp(x):
+    return hw_exp2(x * fx.Float32(LOG2E))
+
+
+def silu(z):
+    return z / (fx.Float32(1.0) + hw_exp(-z))
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- in_proj_ba
+def ba_loads(c, i, parts, k):
+    """in_proj_ba task i's weights for this wave (rows 16 (i / parts) .., K
+    columns ``k`` (i % parts) .. of ``parts k``)."""
+    g, q = i // parts, i % parts
+    return gemv.loads(
+        c["lane"], c["wave"], c["args"]["w_ba"], g * ROWS, k, ldk=parts * k, k0=q * k
+    )
+
+
+def stage_ba(c, i, ops, parts, k, sliced=False):
+    """in_proj_ba task i (``ba_loads``) on the unquantized x rows (LDS rows of
+    ``parts k`` + pad; ``sliced``: only the task's K part, rows of ``k`` +
+    pad) -> fp32 BAPART."""
+    lane, wave = c["lane"], c["wave"]
+    if const_expr(sliced):
+        xl, xrow = c["xl"], k + gemv.LDS_PAD
+    else:
+        xl = c["xl"] + (i % parts) * k // 2
+        xrow = parts * k + gemv.LDS_PAD
+    tiled(
+        c,
+        lambda t0, n: gemv.mfmas(lane, wave, rows_at(xl, xrow, t0), xrow, k, n, ops),
+        lambda t0, n: _ba_out(c, i, t0, n),
+    )
+
+
+@traced
+def _ba_out(c, i, t0, n):
+    s, tid = c["S"], c["tid"]
+    if tid < ROWS * n:
+        r = tid % ROWS
+        j = tid // ROWS
+        c["put"](c["bapart"], (i * s + tok(t0, j)) * ROWS + r, row_sum(c["red"], r, j))
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+def ba_specs(c, t, h, parts):
+    s, nv = c["S"], c["gdn"].nv
+    return [
+        (c["bapart"], (((ro // ROWS) * parts + q) * s + t) * ROWS + ro % ROWS, 1)
+        for ro in (h, nv + h)
+        for q in range(parts)
+    ]
+
+
+def ba_sums(c, t, h, parts, got=None):
+    """Head h's b and a of token t (in_proj_ba rows h, nv + h): the tasks'
+    K parts summed in part order, rounded to bf16."""
+    words = c["poll"](ba_specs(c, t, h, parts)) if got is None else got
+    ba = []
+    for e in range_constexpr(2):
+        v = f32_of(words[e * parts][0])
+        for q in range_constexpr(1, parts):
+            v = v + f32_of(words[e * parts + q][0])
+        ba.append(bf16_round(v))
+    return ba[0], ba[1]
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- gdn
+def gdn_stage(c, t, h, ch):
+    """The task's inputs that need no hand-off, issued before its first poll:
+    the slot, the owned channels' conv window and weights, the state rows and
+    the head's constants."""
+    tid = c["tid"]
+    a, g = c["args"], c["gdn"]
+    k = {}
+    k["slot"] = uniform(ld_i32(a["st_idx"], t))
+    kh = h // (g.nv // g.nk)
+    k["owner"] = (h % (g.nv // g.nk)) == 0
+    # conv: thread < 48 owns channel i of part (q, k, v)
+    ct = fx.min(tid, 3 * VCH - 1)
+    part = ct // VCH
+    i = ct % VCH
+    qk_chan = part * (g.nk * HD) + kh * HD + ch * VCH + i
+    v_chan = 2 * g.nk * HD + h * HD + ch * VCH + i
+    chan = (part < 2).select(qk_chan, v_chan)
+    k["part"], k["i"], k["chan"] = part, i, chan
+    cs = a["conv_st"] + fx.Int64(fx.max(k["slot"], 0)) * fx.Int64(a["cs_seq"]) * 2
+    co = chan * a["cs_dim"]
+    k["cs"], k["co"] = cs, co
+    k["win"] = [ld_bf(cs, co + j * a["cs_tok"]) for j in range(SL)]
+    cw = fx.Vector(
+        bo.buffer_load(rsrc(a["conv_w"]), chan * 2, vec_width=2, dtype=T.i32)
+    )
+    k["cw"] = [bf_lo(cw[0]), bf_hi(cw[0]), bf_lo(cw[1]), bf_hi(cw[1])]
+    # recurrence: thread -> state row ch 16 + tid / 32, K columns (tid % 32) 4 ..
+    vr = ch * VCH + tid // 32
+    k["head_off"] = (h * HD + vr) * HD + (tid % 32) * 4
+    k["sbase"] = (
+        a["rstate"] + fx.Int64(fx.max(k["slot"], 0)) * fx.Int64(a["rs_seq"]) * 4
+    )
+    k["st"] = fx.Vector(
+        bo.buffer_load(rsrc(k["sbase"]), k["head_off"], vec_width=4, dtype=T.f32)
+    )
+    k["a_log"] = ld_f32(a["a_log"], h)
+    k["dtb"] = ld_bf(a["dt_bias"], h)
+    return k
+
+
+@traced
+def gdn_conv(c, k, t, h, ch, xw=None):
+    """The owned channels' conv update: the window shifted (in place), the
+    width-4 conv (each product rounded to bf16, fp32 sum), SiLU -> bf16; q / k
+    out through QK (the key head's owner tasks), v to LDS."""
+    tid = c["tid"]
+    a, g = c["args"], c["gdn"]
+    part, owner = k["part"], k["owner"]
+    if tid < 3 * VCH:
+        if const_expr(xw is None):
+            x = f32_of(c["poll"]([(c["proj"], t * g.proj + k["chan"], 1)])[0][0])
+        else:
+            x = f32_of(xw)
+        owned = (part == 2) | owner
+        if (k["slot"] > 0) & owned:
+            rs = rsrc(k["cs"])
+            for j in range_constexpr(SL):
+                nv = k["win"][j + 1] if j < SL - 1 else x
+                bo.buffer_store(
+                    fx.Float32(nv).to(fx.BFloat16), rs, k["co"] + j * a["cs_tok"]
+                )
+        w, win = k["cw"], k["win"]
+        acc = bf16_round(w[0] * win[0]) + bf16_round(w[1] * win[1])
+        acc = acc + bf16_round(w[2] * win[2])
+        acc = acc + bf16_round(w[3] * x)
+        o = bf16_round(silu(acc))
+        if (part < 2) & owner:
+            kh = h // (g.nv // g.nk)
+            at = ((t * g.nk + kh) * 2 + part) * HD + ch * VCH + k["i"]
+            c["put"](c["qk"], at, o)
+        if part == 2:
+            fx.ptr_store(o, c["vloc"] + k["i"])
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+def decay_beta(b, a, dtb, a_log):
+    """A head's decay exp(-exp(A_log) softplus(a + dt_bias)) and beta =
+    sigmoid(b)."""
+    x = a + dtb
+    sp = hw_log2(fx.Float32(1.0) + hw_exp(x)) * fx.Float32(LN2)
+    sp = (x <= fx.Float32(SOFTPLUS_THRESHOLD)).select(sp, x)
+    gl = -hw_exp(a_log) * sp
+    return hw_exp(gl), sigmoid(b)
+
+
+@traced
+def gdn_gates(c, k, t, h, qkw=None):
+    """The key head's q and k (QK) l2-normed (q scaled by HD^-1/2); the head's
+    decay exp(-exp(A_log) softplus(a + dt_bias)) and beta = sigmoid(b), b and a
+    as the model's ``ba_of`` hands them over."""
+    tid, lane, wave, g = c["tid"], c["lane"], c["wave"], c["gdn"]
+    kh = h // (g.nv // g.nk)
+    if tid < 2 * HD:
+        if const_expr(qkw is None):
+            v = c["poll"]([(c["qk"], (t * g.nk + kh) * 2 * HD + tid, 1)])[0][0]
+        else:
+            v = qkw
+        fx.ptr_store(f32_of(v), c["qkl"] + tid)
+    if const_expr(qkw is None):  # noqa: SIM102 (traced: `and` does not combine traced values)
+        if tid == 2 * HD:
+            b, a = c["ba_of"](c, t, h)
+            decay, beta = decay_beta(b, a, k["dtb"], k["a_log"])
+            fx.ptr_store(decay, c["scal"] + 0)
+            fx.ptr_store(beta, c["scal"] + 1)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    if wave < 2:
+        x0 = fx.ptr_load(c["qkl"] + (wave * HD + lane))
+        x1 = fx.ptr_load(c["qkl"] + (wave * HD + 64 + lane))
+        sc = hw_rsq(wave_sum(x0 * x0 + x1 * x1) + fx.Float32(1e-6))
+        y0, y1 = x0 * sc, x1 * sc
+        qs = fx.Float32(HD**-0.5)
+        y0 = (wave == 0).select(y0 * qs, y0)
+        y1 = (wave == 0).select(y1 * qs, y1)
+        fx.ptr_store(y0, c["qkl"] + (wave * HD + lane))
+        fx.ptr_store(y1, c["qkl"] + (wave * HD + 64 + lane))
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+@traced
+def gdn_recur(c, k, t, h, ch):
+    """State rows 16 ch .. of head h, one token: decay, the delta rule, the new
+    state (in place), o = bf16(h q) -> LDS ``ol``, the chunk's sum of squares
+    -> ONRM."""
+    tid, lane = c["tid"], c["lane"]
+    v = tid // 32
+    k0 = (tid % 32) * 4
+    live = k["slot"] > 0
+    decay = fx.ptr_load(c["scal"] + 0)
+    beta = fx.ptr_load(c["scal"] + 1)
+    qv = [fx.ptr_load(c["qkl"] + (k0 + e)) for e in range(4)]
+    kv = [fx.ptr_load(c["qkl"] + (HD + k0 + e)) for e in range(4)]
+    stv = [live.select(k["st"][e], fx.Float32(0.0)) * decay for e in range(4)]
+    p = stv[0] * kv[0] + stv[1] * kv[1] + stv[2] * kv[2] + stv[3] * kv[3]
+    p = butterfly(p, (16, 8, 4, 2, 1))
+    vn = (fx.ptr_load(c["vloc"] + v) - p) * beta
+    stv = [stv[e] + vn * kv[e] for e in range(4)]
+    o = stv[0] * qv[0] + stv[1] * qv[1] + stv[2] * qv[2] + stv[3] * qv[3]
+    o = bf16_round(butterfly(o, (16, 8, 4, 2, 1)))
+    o = live.select(o, fx.Float32(0.0))
+    if live:
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            fx.Vector.from_elements(stv, fx.Float32),
+            rsrc(k["sbase"]),
+            k["head_off"],
+        )
+    if lane % 32 == 0:
+        fx.ptr_store(o, c["ol"] + v)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    if tid == 0:
+        ss = fx.Float32(0.0)
+        for e in range_constexpr(VCH):
+            x = fx.ptr_load(c["ol"] + e)
+            ss = ss + x * x
+        c["put"](c["onrm"], (t * c["gdn"].nv + h) * NVCH + ch, ss)
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+@traced
+def gdn_norm(c, k, t, h, ch):
+    """Rows 16 ch ..: RMSNormGated over the head's 128 (every chunk's partial):
+    bf16(o rstd w gate(z)) -> ``core``, the gate the model's ``z_gate``."""
+    tid = c["tid"]
+    a, g = c["args"], c["gdn"]
+    if tid < VCH:
+        vr = ch * VCH + tid
+        z0 = 2 * g.nk * HD + g.nv * HD
+        got = c["poll"](
+            [(c["onrm"], (t * g.nv + h) * NVCH + q, 1) for q in range(NVCH)]
+            + [(c["proj"], t * g.proj + z0 + h * HD + vr, 1)]
+        )
+        ss = f32_of(got[0][0])
+        for q in range_constexpr(1, NVCH):
+            ss = ss + f32_of(got[q][0])
+        r = hw_rsq(ss * fx.Float32(1.0 / HD) + fx.Float32(c["norm_eps"]))
+        y = fx.ptr_load(c["ol"] + tid) * r * ld_bf(a["norm_w"], vr)
+        y = y * c["z_gate"](f32_of(got[NVCH][0]))
+        y = (k["slot"] > 0).select(y, fx.Float32(0.0))
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            y.to(fx.BFloat16), rsrc(a["core"]), t * (g.nv * HD) + h * HD + vr
+        )
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+def gdn_round(c, r):
+    """Round r's task of this CTA (``bid - goff`` cyclically + ``BLOCKS r``,
+    clamped into range), its (token, head, chunk) and the round's LDS."""
+    nv = c["gdn"].nv
+    n = c["S"] * nv * NVCH
+    task = (c["bid"] + (BLOCKS - c["goff"])) % BLOCKS + BLOCKS * r
+    tc = fx.min(task, n - 1)
+    cr = dict(c)
+    for name, m in (("qkl", 2 * HD), ("vloc", VCH), ("ol", VCH), ("scal", 4)):
+        cr[name] = c[name] + r * m
+    return cr, task < n, tc // (nv * NVCH), (tc // NVCH) % nv, tc % NVCH
+
+
+def _sel(vals, i):
+    v = vals[0]
+    for j in range(1, len(vals)):
+        v = (i == j).select(vals[j], v)
+    return v
+
+
+@traced
+def gdn_tasks_batched(c, tasks, ks):
+    """``gdn_tasks`` with each hand-off polled for every round at once: the conv
+    inputs and q / k one batch each, b / a and the norm partials a round on a
+    thread group."""
+    tid, g = c["tid"], c["gdn"]
+    rounds = len(tasks)
+    gate_tid = fx.min(tid, 2 * HD - 1)
+    xs = c["poll"](
+        [
+            (c["proj"], t * g.proj + k["chan"], 1)
+            for (_, _, t, _, _), k in zip(tasks, ks)
+        ]
+    )
+    for i, ((cr, live, t, h, ch), k) in enumerate(zip(tasks, ks)):
+        if live:
+            gdn_conv(cr, k, t, h, ch, xs[i][0])
+    # b / a: round r on thread 2 HD + r, in q / k's poll batch
+    r = fx.min(fx.max(tid - 2 * HD, 0), rounds - 1)
+    tr = _sel([tk[2] for tk in tasks], r)
+    hr = _sel([tk[3] for tk in tasks], r)
+    parts = c["ba_parts"]
+    got = c["poll"](
+        [
+            (c["qk"], (t * g.nk + h // (g.nv // g.nk)) * 2 * HD + gate_tid, 1)
+            for _, _, t, h, _ in tasks
+        ]
+        + ba_specs(c, tr, hr, parts)
+    )
+    qks = got[:rounds]
+    b, a = ba_sums(c, tr, hr, parts, got[rounds:])
+    if (tid >= 2 * HD) & (tid < 2 * HD + rounds):
+        args = c["args"]
+        dtb, a_log = ld_bf(args["dt_bias"], hr), ld_f32(args["a_log"], hr)
+        decay, beta = decay_beta(b, a, dtb, a_log)
+        fx.ptr_store(decay, c["scal"] + r * 4)
+        fx.ptr_store(beta, c["scal"] + r * 4 + 1)
+    gpu.barrier()
+    for i, ((cr, live, t, h, ch), k) in enumerate(zip(tasks, ks)):
+        if live:
+            gdn_gates(cr, k, t, h, qks[i][0])
+    for (cr, live, t, h, ch), k in zip(tasks, ks):
+        if live:
+            gdn_recur(cr, k, t, h, ch)
+    # norm: round r on threads 16 r ..
+    r = fx.min(tid // VCH, rounds - 1)
+    tr = _sel([tk[2] for tk in tasks], r)
+    hr = _sel([tk[3] for tk in tasks], r)
+    chr_ = _sel([tk[4] for tk in tasks], r)
+    live = _sel([tk[1] for tk in tasks], r) & (tid < rounds * VCH)
+    slot = _sel([k["slot"] for k in ks], r)
+    a = c["args"]
+    vr = chr_ * VCH + tid % VCH
+    z0 = 2 * g.nk * HD + g.nv * HD
+    got = c["poll"](
+        [(c["onrm"], (tr * g.nv + hr) * NVCH + q, 1) for q in range(NVCH)]
+        + [(c["proj"], tr * g.proj + z0 + hr * HD + vr, 1)]
+    )
+    if live:
+        ss = f32_of(got[0][0])
+        for q in range_constexpr(1, NVCH):
+            ss = ss + f32_of(got[q][0])
+        rr = hw_rsq(ss * fx.Float32(1.0 / HD) + fx.Float32(c["norm_eps"]))
+        y = fx.ptr_load(c["ol"] + (r * VCH + tid % VCH)) * rr * ld_bf(a["norm_w"], vr)
+        y = y * c["z_gate"](f32_of(got[NVCH][0]))
+        y = (slot > 0).select(y, fx.Float32(0.0))
+        bo.buffer_store(
+            y.to(fx.BFloat16), rsrc(a["core"]), tr * (g.nv * HD) + hr * HD + vr
+        )
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+@traced
+def gdn_tasks(c, rounds):
+    """This CTA's GDN tasks (``rounds`` of them) phase by phase: a task waits
+    only on earlier phases of other CTAs' tasks, and every CTA finishes a
+    phase's work before it waits in the next."""
+    tasks = [gdn_round(c, r) for r in range(rounds)]
+    ks = [gdn_stage(cr, t, h, ch) for cr, _, t, h, ch in tasks]
+    if const_expr(rounds >= BATCH_ROUNDS):
+        gdn_tasks_batched(c, tasks, ks)
+    else:
+        _gdn_phases(tasks, ks)
+
+
+@traced
+def _gdn_phases(tasks, ks):
+    phases = (
+        lambda cr, k, t, h, ch: gdn_conv(cr, k, t, h, ch),
+        lambda cr, k, t, h, ch: gdn_gates(cr, k, t, h),
+        lambda cr, k, t, h, ch: gdn_recur(cr, k, t, h, ch),
+        lambda cr, k, t, h, ch: gdn_norm(cr, k, t, h, ch),
+    )
+    for phase in phases:
+        for (cr, live, t, h, ch), k in zip(tasks, ks):
+            if live:
+                phase(cr, k, t, h, ch)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- kernel

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""bf16 GEMV pieces the kernels share: 16 weight rows a task against up
+to 16 token rows in LDS, one ``mfma_f32_16x16x32_bf16`` per 32 K.
+
+K is walked in 128-wide chunks, wave w taking chunks w, w + 8, ...; a lane reads
+64 contiguous bytes of its row a chunk (4 dwordx4 at q 32 + g 8 elements: lane
+group g = lane / 16), and the token rows are read at the same K. The K order
+inside a chunk is a permutation both operands share, so the dot is unchanged.
+"""
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from flydsl.expr import gpu, range_constexpr
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T
+
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.ops import (
+    CM_NT,
+    mfma_bf16,
+    rsrc,
+    traced,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.plan import THREADS, WAVES
+
+ROWS = 16
+KCH = 128
+LDS_PAD = 8  # bf16 a padded token row
+
+
+def chunks(k):
+    """A wave's K chunks for K = ``k``: (count a wave, total)."""
+    n = k // KCH
+    return (n + WAVES - 1) // WAVES, n
+
+
+def loads(lane, wave, w, row0, k, nt=True, ldk=None, k0=0):
+    """This wave's operands of weight rows ``row0`` .. + 16 (row-major, ``ldk``
+    bf16 a row at ``w``, K columns ``k0`` .. ``k0 + k``): a list a chunk
+    (clamped into K: ``mfmas`` zeroes the extra)."""
+    per, n = chunks(k)
+    ldk = k if ldk is None else ldk
+    r_w = rsrc(w)
+    row = row0 + lane % ROWS
+    g = lane // ROWS
+    out = []
+    for i in range(per):
+        ch = fx.min(wave + WAVES * i, n - 1)
+        base = (row * ldk + k0 + ch * KCH + g * 8) // 2
+        out.append(
+            [
+                fx.Vector(
+                    bo.buffer_load(
+                        r_w,
+                        base + 16 * q,
+                        vec_width=4,
+                        dtype=T.i32,
+                        cache_modifier=CM_NT if nt else 0,
+                    )
+                )
+                for q in range(4)
+            ]
+        )
+    return out
+
+
+def mfmas(lane, wave, xl, xrow, k, s, ops):
+    """``loads``' operands against token rows 0 .. s - 1 of the LDS rows ``xl``
+    (``xrow`` bf16 a row) -> this wave's 16x16 accumulator."""
+    per, n = chunks(k)
+    g = lane // ROWS
+    t = fx.min(lane % ROWS, s - 1)
+    acc = fx.Vector.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32)
+    for i in range_constexpr(per):
+        ch = wave + WAVES * i
+        live = ch < n
+        kk = fx.min(ch, n - 1) * KCH + g * 8
+        for q in range_constexpr(4):
+            xb = fx.Vector(
+                fx.ptr_load(
+                    xl + (t * xrow + kk + 32 * q) // 2,
+                    result_type=fx.Vector.make_type(4, fx.Int32),
+                )
+            )
+            if const_live(per, n):
+                xb = fx.Vector.from_elements(
+                    [live.select(xb[d], fx.Int32(0)) for d in range(4)], fx.Int32
+                )
+            acc = mfma_bf16(
+                ops[i][q].bitcast(fx.BFloat16), xb.bitcast(fx.BFloat16), acc
+            )
+    return acc
+
+
+def const_live(per, n):
+    """Whether some wave's last chunk is past K (its MFMA must add zero)."""
+    return per * WAVES != n
+
+
+@traced
+def rows_to_lds(tid, src, k, s, xl, xrow, cm=0, ldk=None, k0=0):
+    """Columns k0 .. k0 + k of token rows 0 .. s - 1 of the bf16 [s, ldk] at
+    ``src`` -> LDS (``xrow`` a row), 16 B a lane."""
+    ldk = k if ldk is None else ldk
+    words = s * k // 8
+    for i in range_constexpr((words + THREADS - 1) // THREADS):
+        e = fx.min(tid + THREADS * i, words - 1)
+        t = e // (k // 8)
+        kk = e % (k // 8) * 8
+        v = fx.Vector(
+            bo.buffer_load(
+                rsrc(src),
+                (t * ldk + k0 + kk) // 2,
+                vec_width=4,
+                dtype=T.i32,
+                cache_modifier=cm,
+            )
+        )
+        if tid + THREADS * i < words:
+            fx.ptr_store(v, xl + (t * xrow + kk) // 2)
+    gpu.barrier()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The MoE and o_proj stages: the MXFP4 arithmetic, the online-MXFP4 GEMV and
+o_proj, the route (the top-10 of 512 logits, the union U of the step's picks)
+and the routed experts (ug, INTER through MXFP4, down) with the shared expert
+fused as expert 512, at the rank's shapes ``c["moe"]`` (``mx_layout.MoeDims``).
+
+A stage reads the kernel context ``c``: ``S``, ``TP``, ``KT`` (picks a token),
+the thread ids, ``rank``, the mailbox (``put``, ``put_bf``, ``put_words``,
+``poll``), LDS (``red``, ``xl``, ``il``, ``contrib``, ``rt``), the scratch
+regions ``sgate`` / ``route`` / ``inter``, the peer regions ``ar`` / ``final``,
+``args`` and the variant flags ``oq`` / ``og`` / ``u1``. Where the
+router logits are is the model's: ``rlog_at(t, lane, i)`` is token t's logit
+of expert lane + 64 i as a poll spec, ``rlog_last`` (n, spec of i) the n
+logits that land last, and CTA ``route_cta`` also puts ROUTE (for the tests).
+"""
+
+import math
+
+import flydsl.expr as fx
+from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops as bo
+from flydsl.expr import const_expr, gpu, range_constexpr, rocdl
+from flydsl.expr import math as fmath
+from flydsl.expr.typing import T, as_ir_value
+
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono import mx_layout as L
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.ops import (
+    CM_NT,
+    bf16_pair,
+    bf16_round,
+    bf_hi,
+    bf_lo,
+    block_excl_scan,
+    div_rn,
+    hw_exp2,
+    ld_i32,
+    mfma_bf16,
+    row_sum,
+    rsrc,
+    traced,
+    uniform,
+    wave_max,
+    xred,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.plan import (
+    BLOCKS,
+    THREADS,
+    WAVES,
+)
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.sync import POLL_MAX
+from vllm.models.qwen3_5.amd.specialized_decode.mono.stages import gemv
+
+E = 512
+TOPK = 10
+ROWS = L.ROWS
+PS_MIN = 4  # rows from which the fused shared expert's ug runs before the route
+DB = 4  # a wave's down slots whose w2 is in flight together
+UG_COLS = 32  # intermediate columns an ug task: an MXFP4 block, quantized there
+UG_K = 4  # K parts a half task's waves split w13's K into (gate | up each)
+LOG2E = 1.0 / math.log(2.0)
+TAG_SLOTS = 256
+
+
+def step_tag(epoch, slot):
+    """This launch's mailbox tag: the step's epoch (bumped once a step, in the
+    graph) and the launch's slot, so no pair of another step or launch passes."""
+    e = uniform(ld_i32(epoch, 0))
+    return (e % (1 << 22)) * TAG_SLOTS + slot + 1
+
+
+def f32_of(w):
+    return w.bitcast(fx.Float32)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- token tiles
+def token_tiles(s):
+    """(first token, tokens) of each 16-token MFMA tile over s rows."""
+    return [(t0, min(ROWS, s - t0)) for t0 in range(0, s, ROWS)]
+
+
+def tok(t0, i):
+    """Token t0 + i of a tile (``red``'s token i)."""
+    return i + t0 if t0 else i
+
+
+def put_acc(c, acc):
+    fx.ptr_store(acc, c["red"] + (c["wave"] * 64 + c["lane"]) * 4)
+    gpu.barrier()
+
+
+def rows_at(xl, xrow, t0):
+    """LDS row t0 of the bf16 rows at ``xl`` (``xrow`` a row)."""
+    return xl + t0 * xrow // 2 if t0 else xl
+
+
+def tiled(c, mfma, epi):
+    """Each 16-token tile in turn: ``mfma(t0, n)`` (its first token, n tokens)
+    -> ``red``, then ``epi(t0, n)`` over its tokens t0 .. t0 + n - 1
+    (``red``'s 0 .. n - 1)."""
+    for t0, n in token_tiles(c["S"]):
+        put_acc(c, mfma(t0, n))
+        epi(t0, n)
+
+
+def sigmoid(z):
+    return fx.Float32(1.0) / (fx.Float32(1.0) + hw_exp2(z * fx.Float32(-LOG2E)))
+
+
+def silu_mul(g, u):
+    return g * sigmoid(g) * u
+
+
+def pow2(code):
+    """The fp32 power of two an e8m0 code stands for."""
+    return (code << 23).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+
+
+def mx_scale(amax):
+    """A 1 x 32 block's MXFP4 e8m0 code from its abs max: ceil_pow2(amax / 6)
+    (RCEIL, AITER's activation quant), clamped to codes 1 .. 253."""
+    d = div_rn(amax, fx.Float32(6.0), fx.Float32(1.0 / 6.0))
+    bits = d.bitcast(fx.Int32)
+    e = (bits >> 23) & 0xFF
+    e = e + ((bits & 0x7FFFFF) != 0).select(fx.Int32(1), fx.Int32(0))
+    return fx.min(fx.max(e, fx.Int32(1)), fx.Int32(253))
+
+
+def mx_scale_round(amax):
+    """``mx_scale`` as the Triton FP4 GEMM's ``dynamic_mxfp4_quant`` takes it:
+    amax's mantissa rounded at its top two bits, then 2^(floor(log2) - 2)
+    (codes clamped to 1 .. 254; a block's elements may saturate at 6)."""
+    e = ((amax.bitcast(fx.Int32) + 0x200000) >> 23) & 0xFF
+    return fx.min(fx.max(e - 2, fx.Int32(1)), fx.Int32(254))
+
+
+def pk_fp4_bf16(old, word, scale, j):
+    """A packed bf16 pair / ``scale`` -> e2m1 codes into byte j of ``old``
+    (nearest even, saturating at 6)."""
+    v = fx.Vector.from_elements([fx.Int32(word)], fx.Int32).bitcast(fx.BFloat16)
+    return fx.Int32(
+        rocdl.cvt_scalef32_pk_fp4_bf16(
+            T.i32,
+            as_ir_value(fx.Int32(old)),
+            as_ir_value(v),
+            as_ir_value(fx.Float32(scale)),
+            j,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def pk_fp4_f32(old, a, b, scale, j):
+    """Two fp32 / ``scale`` -> e2m1 codes into byte j of ``old``."""
+    return fx.Int32(
+        rocdl.cvt_scalef32_pk_fp4_f32(
+            T.i32,
+            as_ir_value(fx.Int32(old)),
+            as_ir_value(fx.Float32(a)),
+            as_ir_value(fx.Float32(b)),
+            as_ir_value(fx.Float32(scale)),
+            j,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def pk_bf16_fp4(word, scale, j):
+    """Byte j of ``word``'s two e2m1 codes times ``scale`` -> a bf16 pair."""
+    v = rocdl.cvt_scalef32_pk_bf16_fp4(
+        T.vec(2, T.bf16),
+        as_ir_value(fx.Int32(word)),
+        as_ir_value(fx.Float32(scale)),
+        j,
+    )
+    return fx.Vector(v).bitcast(fx.Int32)[0]
+
+
+def mfma_f4(a, b, acc, sa, sb):
+    """16x16x128 fp4 x fp4 (e8m0 scales ``sa``, ``sb``: a lane's 32-block)."""
+    return fx.Vector(
+        rocdl.mfma_scale_f32_16x16x128_f8f6f4(
+            T.vec(4, T.f32), [a, b, acc, 4, 4, 0, sa, 0, sb]
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def fp4x8_bf16(word, scale):
+    """The 8 fp4 of ``word`` times ``scale`` -> an MFMA operand (8 bf16 as 4 i32,
+    nibble order: element 2 j, 2 j + 1 from byte j)."""
+    out = []
+    for j in range(4):
+        v = rocdl.cvt_scalef32_pk_bf16_fp4(
+            T.vec(2, T.bf16),
+            as_ir_value(fx.Int32(word)),
+            as_ir_value(fx.Float32(scale)),
+            j,
+        )
+        out.append(fx.Vector(v).bitcast(fx.Int32)[0])
+    return fx.Vector.from_elements(out, fx.Int32)
+
+
+def fp4_mfmas(tile, scale, xl, xoff, acc):
+    """One 128-K step: a lane's 16 B of fp4 (4 dwords, K 32 (lane / 16) + 8 q ..
+    for dword q) against the bf16 B rows at LDS ``xl`` + ``xoff`` (the same K)."""
+    for q in range_constexpr(4):
+        xb = fx.Vector(
+            fx.ptr_load(
+                xl + (xoff + 8 * q) // 2,
+                result_type=fx.Vector.make_type(4, fx.Int32),
+            )
+        )
+        a = fp4x8_bf16(tile[q], scale)
+        acc = mfma_bf16(a.bitcast(fx.BFloat16), xb.bitcast(fx.BFloat16), acc)
+    return acc
+
+
+def fp4_tile(r_w, at):
+    return fx.Vector(
+        bo.buffer_load(r_w, at, vec_width=4, dtype=T.i32, cache_modifier=CM_NT)
+    )
+
+
+def scale_word(r_s, byte_index):
+    return fx.Int32(bo.buffer_load(r_s, byte_index // 4, vec_width=1, dtype=T.i32))
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- fp4 GEMV
+def _paired(k):
+    """K's steps split over the waves in even runs: a wave's run contiguous, a
+    scale word two steps. Else wave w takes steps w, w + 8, ..., a word each."""
+    return k // L.FP4_STEP % (2 * WAVES) == 0
+
+
+def fp4_gemv_loads(lane, wave, w, ws, rg, k, rows, shuffled=True, live=None):
+    """An online-MXFP4 linear's rows 16 rg .. (``rows`` of them, K ``k``) for
+    this wave: its K steps' tiles and their scale words (``_paired``; past the
+    last step clamped, ``fp4_gemv`` zeroes those). ``shuffled``: the ASM FP4
+    GEMM's shuffled weight and scales, else the Triton FP4 GEMM's row-major
+    weight and transposed scales (a word a step). ``live`` false: no memory
+    access (zeros)."""
+    n = k // L.FP4_STEP
+    if live is None:
+        r_w, r_s = rsrc(w), rsrc(ws)
+    else:
+        nw = rows * k // 2
+        ns = rows * L.scale_cols(k) if shuffled else k // 32 * rows
+        r_w = rsrc(w, live.select(fx.Int32(nw), fx.Int32(0)))
+        r_s = rsrc(ws, live.select(fx.Int32(ns), fx.Int32(0)))
+    row = rg * ROWS + lane % ROWS
+    cols = L.scale_cols(k)
+    if const_expr(shuffled and _paired(k)):
+        per = n // WAVES
+        tiles = [
+            fp4_tile(r_w, L.fp4_tile_dword(0, rg, k, wave * per + i, lane))
+            for i in range(per)
+        ]
+        words = [
+            scale_word(
+                r_s, L.scale_index(row, 4 * (wave * per + 2 * i) + lane // 16, cols)
+            )
+            for i in range(per // 2)
+        ]
+        return tiles + words
+    per = (n + WAVES - 1) // WAVES
+    sts = [fx.min(wave + WAVES * i, n - 1) for i in range(per)]
+    if const_expr(not shuffled):
+        tiles = [fp4_tile(r_w, L.fp4_row_dword(rg, k, st, lane)) for st in sts]
+        words = [
+            scale_word(r_s, L.scale_t_index(row, 4 * st + lane // 16, rows))
+            for st in sts
+        ]
+        return tiles + words
+    tiles = [fp4_tile(r_w, L.fp4_tile_dword(0, rg, k, st, lane)) for st in sts]
+    words = [
+        scale_word(r_s, L.scale_index(row, 4 * st + lane // 16, cols)) for st in sts
+    ]
+    return tiles + words
+
+
+def fp4_gemv(lane, wave, xl, xrow, k, s, rg, ops, shuffled=True):
+    """The ``fp4_gemv_loads`` operands against the MXFP4-exact bf16 rows at LDS
+    ``xl`` (row stride ``xrow``) -> this wave's fp32 partial MFMA tile."""
+    n = k // L.FP4_STEP
+    t = fx.min(lane % 16, s - 1)
+    acc = fx.Vector.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32)
+    if const_expr(shuffled and _paired(k)):
+        per = n // WAVES
+        for i in range_constexpr(per):
+            code = (ops[per + i // 2] >> L.scale_code_shift(i, rg)) & 0xFF
+            xoff = t * xrow + (wave * per + i) * L.FP4_STEP + 32 * (lane // 16)
+            acc = fp4_mfmas(ops[i], pow2(code), xl, xoff, acc)
+        return acc
+    per = (n + WAVES - 1) // WAVES
+    for i in range_constexpr(per):
+        raw = wave + WAVES * i
+        st = fx.min(raw, n - 1)
+        # a transposed scale's rows are bytes: row 16 rg + lane % 16 at byte
+        # lane % 4 of its word (``rows`` a multiple of 4)
+        shift = L.scale_code_shift(st, rg) if shuffled else 8 * (lane % 4)
+        code = (ops[per + i] >> shift) & 0xFF
+        scale = pow2(code)
+        if const_expr(per * WAVES != n):
+            scale = (raw < n).select(scale, fx.Float32(0.0))
+        xoff = t * xrow + st * L.FP4_STEP + 32 * (lane // 16)
+        acc = fp4_mfmas(ops[i], scale, xl, xoff, acc)
+    return acc
+
+
+def fp4q_gemv(lane, wave, xl, k, s, rg, ops, shuffled=True):
+    """The ``fp4_gemv_loads`` operands against the x rows' MXFP4 codes at LDS
+    ``xl`` (``quant_x_fp4``'s layout), one scaled fp4 MFMA a step -> this
+    wave's fp32 partial MFMA tile. K's steps split evenly over the waves."""
+    n = k // L.FP4_STEP
+    t = fx.min(lane % 16, s - 1)
+    acc = fx.Vector.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32)
+
+    def step(acc, tile, code, st):
+        xq = (t * xq_row(k) + st * (L.FP4_STEP // 2)) // 4 + 4 * (lane // 16)
+        xb = fx.Vector(
+            fx.ptr_load(xl + xq, result_type=fx.Vector.make_type(4, fx.Int32))
+        )
+        sb = fx.ptr_load(xl + (xq_scales(s, k) + t * (k // 32) + 4 * st + lane // 16))
+        return mfma_f4(tile, xb, acc, code, sb)
+
+    if const_expr(shuffled and _paired(k)):
+        per = n // WAVES
+        for i in range_constexpr(per):
+            code = (ops[per + i // 2] >> L.scale_code_shift(i, rg)) & 0xFF
+            acc = step(acc, ops[i], code, wave * per + i)
+        return acc
+    per = n // WAVES
+    assert per * WAVES == n
+    for i in range_constexpr(per):
+        st = wave + WAVES * i
+        shift = L.scale_code_shift(st, rg) if shuffled else 8 * (lane % 4)
+        acc = step(acc, ops[i], (ops[per + i] >> shift) & 0xFF, st)
+    return acc
+
+
+@traced
+def ksplit_rows(c, region, at, q, parts, out, t0=0, n=None):
+    """A K-split GEMV task's 16 rows (``red``, tokens t0 .. t0 + n - 1; part
+    q of ``parts``): parts q > 0 publish fp32 partials to ``region`` at
+    ``at(qq, t, r)``; part 0 adds them in part order, rounds to bf16 (the
+    GEMM's output) and passes token t's rows r, r + 1 to ``out(t, r, vs)``."""
+    tid = c["tid"]
+    n = c["S"] if n is None else n
+    if q > 0:  # noqa: SIM102 (traced: `and` does not combine traced values)
+        if tid < ROWS * n:
+            r = tid % ROWS
+            i = tid // ROWS
+            c["put"](region, at(q, tok(t0, i), r), row_sum(c["red"], r, i))
+    if q == 0:  # noqa: SIM102
+        if tid < (ROWS // 2) * n:
+            r = 2 * (tid % (ROWS // 2))
+            i = tid // (ROWS // 2)
+            t = tok(t0, i)
+            got = c["poll"](
+                [
+                    (region, at(qq, t, r + d), 1)
+                    for d in range(2)
+                    for qq in range(1, parts)
+                ]
+            )
+            vs = []
+            for d in range_constexpr(2):
+                v = row_sum(c["red"], r + d, i)
+                for qq in range_constexpr(parts - 1):
+                    v = v + f32_of(got[d * (parts - 1) + qq][0])
+                vs.append(bf16_round(v))
+            out(t, r, vs)
+    gpu.barrier()
+
